label: 冒险预设角色 Adventure Pregens

items.name: 轻灵兽
items.expectedDescription:
Skittermanders are energetic, six-armed humanoids with brightly colored fur. Skittermanders accomplish tasks with chaotic enthusiasm and typically enjoy teamwork, defying even their would-be conquerors through collaboration.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.kDLQjSlW2N1oEwji]{Skittermander}
items.description:
轻灵兽是精力充沛的六臂类人生物，生有色彩鲜艳的毛发。他们以混乱而热烈的劲头完成任务，通常喜欢团队合作，甚至会通过协作反抗那些企图征服他们的人。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.kDLQjSlW2N1oEwji]{轻灵兽}

items.name: 六臂
items.expectedDescription: You have six arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to six hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
items.description: 你有六条手臂，这使得你可以持握和持用多达六只占用手的武器和装备。任何时候，一双手被指定为你的启动手。你可以通过换手动作切换为另一双启动手，这是一个单动作。你只能使用启动手执行动作。有关扮演超过两只手的角色的更多信息，请参考第254页。

items.name: 攀爬轻灵兽
items.expectedDescription: You never mastered coordinating all six of your arms for manual manipulation, instead using the lowest two limbs for the extra mobility, balance, and stabilization of a natural climber. You have four arms (rather than six) and four legs (rather than two). You gain a climb Speed equal to your base land Speed and can climb using your feet, leaving your four arms free.
items.description: 您从未掌握过协调所有六只手臂进行手上操作的能力，转而使用其中最下端的两只肢体来获得额外的灵活性、平衡感与稳定性，如同天生的攀爬者。您有四只手臂（而不是六只）和四条腿（而不是两条）。你获得等同你基本陆上速度的攀爬速度，并能用双足攀爬，使四臂保持自由活动状态。

items.name: 黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've always had a knack for computers and virtual spaces and pride yourself on your ability to learn technical secrets. The open networks known as infospheres are your home and the place you can do your best work. You're highly competent when it comes to cracking code or accessing secure data.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Infosphere Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9] skill feat.
items.description:
你一直对计算机和虚拟空间很有天赋，并努力学习技术秘密。被称为信息圈的开放网络是你的家，也是你大展身手的地方。无论是破解代码还是访问加密数据，你都游刃有余。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是敏捷或智力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的计算机技能和信息圈学识（Infosphere Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9]（Phreaker）技能专长。

items.name: 电话黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've learned how to hack using alternative methods. You can use Computers to Disable a Device or Hack a system using any computer, comm unit, or terminal instead of a hacking toolkit. If you're an expert in Computers and the equipment you use is at least 3rd level, you gain a +1 item bonus to Disable a Device or Hack.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf] skill feat, you can use this feat to Combat Hack or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} without a hacking toolkit.
items.description:
你学会了以其他方法骇入。你可以用任意计算机、通讯器或终端，使用计算机技能解除装置或骇入系统，无需骇客工具包。如果你在计算机达到专家，且所用设备至少为3级，则你解除装置或骇入的检定获得+1物品加值。

特殊如果你具有@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]技能专长，就可以使用此专长，在没有骇客工具包的情况下进行战斗骇入或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}。

items.name: 织维巫师
items.expectedDescription:
A strange paradoxical event forever altered your existence, and now you can manipulate reality. You explore the infinite possibilities of the multiverse, possibly visualizing variant timelines or parallel worlds. You create fields that subvert space and time, allowing you to cast powerful magic. You've learned to focus on an anchoring memory, concept, or object to help you identify reality.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.Qaue1LUZUrEFYfT0]{Witchwarper}
items.description:
一场奇异的悖论事件永久改变了你的存在，如今你可以操纵现实。你探索多元宇宙的无限可能，或许还能看到不同的时间线或平行世界。你创造颠覆时空的场域，借此施展强大的魔法。你已学会专注于一段作为锚点的记忆、一个概念或一件物品，以帮助自己辨识现实。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.Qaue1LUZUrEFYfT0]{织维巫师}

items.name: 悖论
items.expectedDescription:
Your existence is contrary to the status quo of the universe, causing quantum ripples that empower your spellcasting talent and open doorways to other worlds. Perhaps you're from an alternate reality or a different timeline, or perhaps you experienced an unnatural phenomenon that altered your path, discovered a time-glitching alien device, or wrote a treatise on quantum magical theory. Whatever your story, you've become a living paradox.

At 1st level, choose your paradox. Your chosen paradox determines the tradition of your spells, additional trained skills, additional spells you learn, and the effects of your quantum field. You also gain Focus Points and special focus spells called warp spells based on your paradox.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.42tQJXhySw9QKcn6]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.hFIB6wlYGK93zl4g]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.1E12XmyqzIK1jXrY]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.cxBVbSITniNRwfMi]
items.description:
你的存在本质有别于当下的宇宙，这种异常激发的量子涟漪正是你施法能力的源泉，为你开启通往崭新世界的道路。你可能来自被覆写的现实或是不同的时间线，也可能你接触了足以改变你命运的现象，发现了干涉时间的异星设备，或是发表了一篇关于量子魔法论的论文。不论你经历如何，你已经成为了活着的悖论。

在1级，选择你的悖论，其决定了你的施法根源、学习的额外法术、额外的受训技能，以及你量子场域中的效应。你也会获得聚能点和被称为曲织法术（warp spell）的聚能法术，其基于你的悖论。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.42tQJXhySw9QKcn6]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.hFIB6wlYGK93zl4g]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.1E12XmyqzIK1jXrY]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.cxBVbSITniNRwfMi]

items.name: 量子场域
items.expectedDescription:
You can draw on paradoxical forces to create a reality-warping quantum field. It might manifest as a haze in the air that shows shimmers of alternate realities, appear as walls of glowing magical equations, or any other display you choose. The effects of your quantum field are determined by your paradox. You can further enhance and manipulate your quantum field through your witchwarper feat selections and by casting warp spells. You can activate or extend the duration of your quantum field by using reality-warping magic.

You have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0] action, which lets you activate your quantum field. This action gains the arcane or occult trait based on the tradition of your selected paradox. You also have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.30Nw5q4vWKCQIBIZ], which lets you establish your quantum field quickly at the start of combat.
items.description:
你可以借由彼此矛盾的力量创造出一片曲织现实的量子场域。这可能具现为弥漫在空气中的薄雾，不同现实在其中闪烁，也可能表现为写满晦涩魔法方程的墙体，或是你选择的任何形式。量子场域的效果由你的悖论决定。你可以通过织维巫师专长或者施放曲织法术来进一步增强和操控你的量子场域。你可以用曲织现实的魔力来激活你的量子场域或者延长其持续时间。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0]动作，其允许你激活你的量子场域。这一动作会根据你悖论决定的施法根源相应获得奥术或异能特征。此外，你还获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.30Nw5q4vWKCQIBIZ]动作，可以在遭遇开始时快速激活量子场域。

items.name: 锚点
items.expectedDescription:
Whatever paradox altered the course of your existence, something helps keep you anchored to reality. This might be a physical object you carry, memories of your home, or loved ones. At 1st level, select an anchor.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.ENxkQJEIkz35yuMT]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.idjill6Zh7b3SLqE]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.Z1sThY5XgXiXQBIy]
items.description:
不论悖论如何改变了你的存在，仍有某些存在将你锚定在现实中。这可能是随身携带的实物，可能是你对家乡或所爱的记忆。在1级，选择一个锚点。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.ENxkQJEIkz35yuMT]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.idjill6Zh7b3SLqE]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.Z1sThY5XgXiXQBIy]

items.name: 独立法阵
items.expectedDescription: You can cast spells directly into your quantum field. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.E7HvICcH9CRAVzGc] action.
items.description: 你可以直接向量子场域施展法术。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.E7HvICcH9CRAVzGc]动作。

items.name: 无穷演算

There's a hidden code that powers the Universe and realms beyond, and by focusing your intellect, you can tap into it and see the equations.

Tradition arcane

Paradox Skill Computers

Whenever you Sustain your quantum field, you can Seek or Recall Knowledge against a target in your quantum field as a free action.
items.description:
不为人知的代码驱动着宇宙及其之外的领域，而不知何故，你能够集中才智来利用它——那些方程现于你眼中。

施法根源奥术

量子场域当你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]时，你可以将结果应用在处于你量子场域中的两个相关生物、危害、无主物品或者效果。并且每当你维持量子场域，你就能用自由动作对你量子场域中的一个目标进行搜索或回忆知识。

items.name: 曲织现实
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements Your quantum field isn't active.

Your quantum field activates and lasts as long as you Sustain it (up to 10 minutes) or until the end of your next turn. Your quantum field is a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] centered on a point you choose within 100 feet. While your quantum field is active, you can use actions that have the anchoring trait. Your quantum field's other specific effects are determined by your paradox. Choose whether any given creature in the area is affected by your quantum field when you Warp Reality, each time you Sustain it, and when a creature enters your quantum field. Each time you Sustain a quantum field with the Sustain action (instead of an anchoring action), you can move it to a new position within 100 feet.

Your quantum field automatically deactivates if you're knocked out, if you Dismiss it, or if you move more than 100 feet away from it.
items.description:
需求 你的量子场域未激活。

你的量子场域激活，持续到你的下个回合结束，或者你可以维持其至多10分钟。你的量子场域是一个中心在你100尺内的@Template[type:burst|distance:20]区域。当你的量子场域被激活，你可以使用具有锚定特征的动作。你的量子场域的其他效果由你的悖论决定。当你使用曲织现实动作、每次你维持量子场域或一个生物进入你的量子场域时，你可以选择区域中的任何生物是否受到量子场域影响。每当你维持量子场域时（但不包括使用具有锚定特征的动作），你可以将它移动到100尺内一个新的位置。

你的量子场域会在你被击败、你将之解消、或者你移动远离其100尺以上时自动消散。

items.name: 量子脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You're always ready to let loose with your paradoxical abilities, and when imperiled, you instinctively release a pulse of quantum energy. As combat begins, you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0].
items.description:
触发 你骰先攻。

你随时准备好施放你的矛盾力量，危急时刻只需思绪一动便能创造场域。在战斗开始时，你使用@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0]动作。

items.name: 核心回忆
items.expectedDescription:
No matter where you travel, precious memories keep you tethered to reality. Whatever the nature and number of your memories, you can focus on them to remind yourself which of the infinite possible realities impacts you the most: your own.

Anchor Benefit During your daily preparations, choose a skill you're trained in. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} in that skill. If you're expert in that skill, and the skill has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]{Automatic Knowledge} in that skill.

Anchoring Effect Reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} condition by 1. You can only benefit from this once per round.
items.description:
无论你行至何方，珍贵的记忆都会将你与现实紧密相连。无论这些记忆的性质与数量如何，你都能专注于它们，从而提醒自己：在这无数种可能的现实中，对你影响最深的始终是你亲身经历的那一个。

锚点增益在你每日准备时，选择一个你受训的技能，你在这一技能上获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]专长。如果你在这一技能上为专家，并且该技能可以用于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作，那么你还会在该技能上获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.H3I2X0f7v4EzwxuN]专长。

锚定效果你的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]状态减少1点。你每轮只能从此效果中受益一次。

items.name: 独立法阵
items.expectedDescription: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase the spell's range to 100 feet. That spell only affects targets inside your quantum field, and the area of the spell doesn't extend beyond your quantum field.
items.description: 如果你的下个动作是施展一个具有射程的法术，则将这个法术的射程提升至100尺。该法术只影响你量子场域内的目标，并且法术的区域不会延伸到你的量子场域之外。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.
items.description:
秘术师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及来自你联结的额外法术和戏法。你从你联结对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术，或者从你获得许可的其他源自你魔法根源的法术中进行选择。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。当你获得新的法术环位时，你的第一个新法术总是对应环级的来自你联结的授予法术，然后你可以选择其他你获取的法术。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，可能会想替换之前学过的部分法术。每次你升级并学习新法术时，可以将一个旧法术替换为另一个同环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但你不能替换顿悟法术或联结法术。你也可以通过休整期重训替换法术。

织维巫师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及悖论赋予你的额外法术和戏法。你从你悖论对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，你可能会想要替换之前学习的一些法术。每次你获得新的等级学习新的法术时，你可以将一个旧法术置换为一个同一环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但是你不能替换悖论的授予法术。你也可以通过休整期重训来替换法术。

items.name: 织维巫师施法
items.expectedDescription:
Your paradox grants you magical power. You can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a witchwarper, when you cast spells, you might describe your revelations about other realities aloud, accompanied by elegant gestures while arcane equations or occult symbols blaze around you.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a witchwarper, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Charisma or Intelligence modifier, depending on which you chose for your key attribute.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witchwarper spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

Warp Spells

You can create powerful magical phenomena known as warp spells. Warp spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a warp spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to contemplate infinite worlds or conduct quantum magical research.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Warp spells have the anchoring trait, unlike other focus spells. This trait means you can only use warp spells while your quantum field is active, and you automatically Sustain your quantum field when you cast warp spells.

You learn warp spells based on your paradox.
items.description:
你的悖论赋予了你魔法力量。你可以用施放法术行动来施法。作为织维巫师，当你施法时，你可能会大声描述关于其他现实的启示，兼有优雅的手势，而神秘符号或者奥法方程在你身周闪烁。

你每日最多可以施放三个1环法术。在施放法术前你必须已知这些法术，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习法术。你每日可以施放的法术数量被称为法术位。

随着你织维巫师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如下表所示。

你的某些法术需要你尝试一次法术攻击掷骰来确认法术的起效程度，或是迫使你的敌人投骰来对抗法术DC（通常是尝试一次豁免骰）。你的法术攻击骰和法术DC取决于你选择的关键属性以智力或魅力作为调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整，这通常等于你拥有的织维巫师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级织维巫师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级织维巫师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

曲织法术

你可以创造被称为曲织法术的强大魔法现象。曲织法术是一种聚能法术。施放一个曲织法术需要花费1聚能点，而你初始拥有一个含有1聚能点的聚能池。每日准备期间，你会将聚能池补满；你也可以花费10分钟使用重新聚能活动，沉思无穷世界或进行量子魔法研究，以恢复1聚能点。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你的等级的一半，向上取整，类似戏法一般。聚能法术不需要法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。选取专长能够给予你更多聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，但你的聚能池拥有不能超过3点聚能点。

与其他聚能法术不同，曲织法术具有锚定特征。此特征意味着你只能在量子场域生效期间使用曲织法术，且施放曲织法术时，你会自动维持量子场域。

你学习的曲织法术基于你的悖论。

items.name: 标志性法术
items.expectedDescription: You've learned to cast some of your spells more flexibly, granting you extra control over your spellcasting. For each spell rank you have access to, choose one spell of that rank to be a signature spell. You don't need to learn heightened versions of signature spells separately; instead, you can heighten these spells freely. If you've learned a signature spell at a higher level than its minimum, you can also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If you swap out a signature spell, you can choose a replacement signature spell of the same spell rank at which you learned the previous spell. You can also retrain specifically to change a signature spell to a different spell of that rank without swapping any spells; this takes as much time as retraining a spell normally does.
items.description: 你学会了更灵活地施放部分法术，赋予你对施法的额外控制力。从每个你获得的法术环级上选择一个该等级的法术作为你的标志性法术。你不需要另外学习标志性法术的升阶版本；相反，你可以自由升阶这些法术。如果你学习了一个超过原本等级的标志性法术，你可以无需学习便施展这个法术的低级版本。如果你替换了标志性法术，你可以重新选择一个相同等级法术作为新的标志性法术。你还可以通过重训在不替换法术的情况下改变标志性法术，这会花费和通常重训法术相同的时间。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 电弧击
items.expectedDescription:
An arc of lightning leaps from one target to another. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一段电弧从一个目标跳跃到另一个目标。每个目标承受2d4电击伤害，这有一次基础反射豁免。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 重填武器
items.expectedDescription:
You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its expend until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less.

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.
items.description:
你触碰一件没有剩余弹药的武器，用魔法能量为其充能。直到你的下一回合结束时，目标会获得与其“耗弹”相等的弹药或充能，并允许任何持有目标的人使用该武器进行一次打击。该法术只能为使用弹药且弹药价格不超过10个信用点的武器充能。

升阶（3环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的两倍。

升阶（6环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的三倍。

升阶（9环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的四倍。

items.name: 念动射弹
items.expectedDescription:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你向目标射出射程内一个未固定、无主且负载不超过1的物体。对目标尝试一次法术攻击掷骰。如果你命中，你造成2d6的钝击，穿刺，或者挥砍伤害（对应于你所扔出的物体）。射出物体的特殊特征或者魔法特性不会影响该攻击或者伤害。

大成功 你造成双倍伤害。

成功 你造成完整伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 刺激细胞
items.expectedDescription:
You vitalize and stimulate the target at a cellular level, giving it a temporary burst of energy that unfortunately takes an exhausting toll. The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action to Stride or Strike. After that round ends, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} until it can rest for 10 minutes.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to six creatures by using 2 actions to Cast this Spell.
items.description:
你从细胞层面激发目标的活力，使其获得短暂的能量爆发，但不幸的是，这将使其精疲力竭。目标获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]状态，并可以使用额外的行动行走或打击。该轮结束后，目标会变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]，直到休息10分钟。

升阶（6环）你可以使用2动作施放此法术，最多同时以6个生物为目标。

items.name: 眩彩喷射
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a swirling multitude of colors that overwhelms creatures based on their Will saves.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, and dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is stunned for 1 round and blinded for 1 minute.
items.description:
你释放旋转变幻的纷繁色彩，根据生物的意志豁免结果对其产生影响。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}1轮。

失败 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}1轮，并目眩1分钟。

大失败 该生物震慑1轮，并目盲1分钟。

items.name: 力场飞弹
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.
items.description:
你发射出一道固态的魔力碎片，射向一个你能看见的生物。它自动命中，并造成1d4+1力场伤害。你施放该法术时每额外使用一个动作，你射出的碎片增加一个，最大为3个动作发射三个碎片。你为每个碎片分别选择目标。如果你对同一个目标射击超过1个碎片，将伤害合计后再计算伤害加值，减值，抗力，弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你花费的每个动作额外射出一枚碎片。

items.name: 料敌机先
items.expectedDescription:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}
items.description:
在你的回合结束前，你下一次尝试攻击掷骰时，骰两次并使用较好的结果。该攻击会忽视对攻击掷骰的环境减值，以及因目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}而需进行的任何纯骰检定。然后你临时免疫料敌机先10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：料敌机先}

items.name: 腐蚀转化
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米粒子，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你会造成3d8酸蚀伤害加1d6持续酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 网络筛查
items.expectedDescription:
You ritually sift through the local infosphere and gain mystical insight about a topic. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes.

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results. The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of sift the sphere during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, it's possible to get a different result.

Heightened (4th) The spell can predict results up to 1 week into the future.
items.description:
你以仪式梳理本地信息圈，获得关于某个主题的神秘洞见。施放此法术期间，你询问采取某项特定行动的结果。法术可以预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并从以下结果中揭示GM认为最可能发生的一项。

  • 吉结果将是好的。
  • 凶结果将是坏的。
  • 吉凶参半结果将有好有坏。

items.description: 你使开花的藤蔓或其他植物从一件无人持有的科技物体上长出。植物从目标物体上爆发，填满20尺爆发内的所有方格。每当生物在区域内开始其回合时，它受到2d6穿刺伤害（基础反射豁免）。大失败时，该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}，持续1轮，或直到其对抗你的法术DC成功脱逃。植物覆盖物体，使生物在法术持续时间内必须成功通过一次@Check[flat|dc:5]，才能实际接触该物体。

items.name: 超速

items.expectedDescription:

items.name: 商用型渗透者工具包

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 商用型数据接口
items.expectedDescription: This cybernetic is a programmable data port installed into your body, allowing you to access computers and digital storage devices. Any handheld computer can connect to the port, while larger systems typically require an adapter cable. You don't need an interface to access the system, as it connects directly to your nervous system via the datajack. items.description: 这种电控殖装是一种可编程的数据端口，并与你的身体整合，让你能够存取计算机与数位储存装置。任何手持式计算机都可以直接插入端口，而更大型的系统则通常需要转接线。你不需要透过介面来存取系统，因为它会透过数据接口直接连入你的神经系统。你仍然必须进行任何与操作该装置有关的技能检定，例如用计算机来访问系统。有些封闭系统完全禁止直接访问数据。

items.name: 商用型藏物义肢
items.expectedDescription:
You can conceal items inside a hidden compartment in one of your limbs (such as an arm, leg, or tail) and protect them with a passcode. The compartment holds items of negligible Bulk and items of light Bulk that are small enough to fit in your limb or can otherwise be folded or contracted to fit. A hideaway in a leg (in a human) can typically hold more than one in an arm, and your size also adjusts the capacity at the GM's discretion.

When the compartment is closed, the seam in your limb is difficult to detect. You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Conceal an Object in a hideaway limb. Though this compartment can foil a cursory pat down, many security checkpoints include a scan to detect such devices.

Activate—Draw 1 (manipulate)

items.description:

隔舱关闭时，你肢体上的接缝很难察觉。你在将物品藏匿于藏物附肢中的隐秘检定上获得+1物品加值。虽然隔舱能骗过草率的拍身搜查，但许多安检点会扫描以探测这类装置。

启动—拔取 1 （操作）

效果 你交互取出一件@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{藏匿}于藏物附肢中的物品。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 移变激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You release a surge of magical energy that temporarily changes the type of damage dealt by a weapon. The next Strike the weapon makes deals your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage and deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Heightened (+2) The extra damage increases by 1d6.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]
items.description:
你释放出一股魔法能量，暂时改变目标武器造成的伤害类型。使用该武器的下一次打击会造成酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰、音波中由你选择的一种伤害类型，并且额外造成1d6伤害，类型为武器正常的伤害类型。

升阶（+2）额外伤害增加1d6。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]

items.name: 料敌机先
items.expectedDescription:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}
items.description:
在你的回合结束前，你下一次尝试攻击掷骰时，骰两次并使用较好的结果。该攻击会忽视对攻击掷骰的环境减值，以及因目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或者@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}而需进行的任何纯骰检定。然后你临时免疫料敌机先10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：料敌机先}

items.name: 雷击术
items.expectedDescription:
You call down a tendril of lightning that cracks with thunder, dealing 1d12 electricity damage and 1d4 sonic damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. A target wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a –1 circumstance bonus to its save, and if damaged by the spell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 electricity and 1d4 sonic.
items.description:
你呼唤一道伴随着雷鸣之声的闪电，对目标造成1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害，基础反射豁免。穿戴金属护甲或者由金属构成的生物在豁免中承受-1环境减值，若它们受到该法术的伤害，会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12点电击以及1d4点音波。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 凿爪术
items.expectedDescription:
You temporarily morph your limb into a clawed appendage. Make a melee spell attack roll against your target's AC. If you hit, you deal your choice of 2d6 slashing damage or 2d6 piercing damage, plus 2 persistent bleed damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage and double bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
items.description:
你将你的肢体暂时变为一个长爪的附肢。进行一次近战法术攻击掷骰，对抗你的目标的AC。如果你命中，你选择造成2d6挥砍或者2d6穿刺伤害，以及2点持续流血伤害。在大成功时，你造成双倍伤害加上双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d6，并且持续流血伤害增加1。

items.name: 魔法伎俩
items.expectedDescription:
The simplest magic does your bidding. You can perform simple magical effects for as long as you Sustain the spell. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose one of four options.

  • Cook Cool, warm, or flavor 1 pound of nonliving material.
  • Lift Slowly lift an unattended object of light Bulk or less 1 foot off the ground.
  • Make Create a temporary object of negligible Bulk, made of congealed magical substance. The object looks crude and artificial and is extremely fragile-it can't be used as a tool, weapon, or locus or cost for a spell.
  • Tidy Color, clean, or soil an object of light Bulk or less. You can affect an object of 1 Bulk with 10 rounds of concentration, and a larger object at 1 minute per Bulk.

Prestidigitation can't deal damage or cause adverse conditions. Any actual change to an object (beyond what is noted above) persists only as long as you Sustain the spell.
items.description:
最简单的魔法帮你完成杂务。只要你维持该法术，你就可以产生简单的魔法效果。每当你维持该法术时，你可以选择四个选项中的一个。

  • 烹饪 为1磅非活物材料冷却，加热，或者调味。
  • 抬起 将一件轻负载或者更低的无主物品缓慢抬离地面1尺。
  • 创造 创造一个负载可忽略的临时物体，它由凝结的魔法物质组成。该物体看起来粗糙、不自然，且极其脆弱——它无法被用做工具、武器、施法载体或法术费用。
  • 整理 为一件轻负载或者更低的物体染色，清洁，或者弄脏它。你可以通过10轮专注来影响一件1负载的物体，对于更大的物体为每负载1分钟。

魔法伎俩无法造成伤害或者负面效果。对一件物体的任何改变（在上述内容之外的）只会在你仍维持该法术时持续。

items.name: 回旋弹
items.expectedDescription:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一道由闪烁钢铁构成的旋转圆盘或光滑球体在目标之间弹射跃动。造成2d4钝击或挥砍伤害，需要进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 念动之手
items.expectedDescription:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.
items.description:
你创造出一只漂浮着的魔法手掌，它可以隐形或者宛如幽灵，它能抓住目标物体并向着任意方向缓慢漂浮至多20尺。当你维持法术时，你能够将物体移动额外20尺。若物体位于空中之时法术结束，那么该物体便会坠落。

升阶（3环） 你能以一个1负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

升阶（5环） 法术射程增加至60尺，而且你能以一个1负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

升阶（7环） 法术射程增加至60尺，而且你能以一个2负载或更轻的无主物体为目标。

items.name: 曲织或然
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You fail an attack roll or saving throw.

You open your mind to read the underlying probability of the multiverse. Reroll the failed check and take the better result.
items.description:
触发你在一次攻击检定或者豁免骰中失败。

你展开思维来阅读多元宇宙中的潜藏可能。重骰失败的检定并使用其中较高的结果。

items.name: 第二皮肤
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
items.description:
强化： 0

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

items.name: 商用型黑客工具包
items.expectedDescription: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network.
items.description: 骇入计算机的计算机检定需要使用黑客工具包。你可以使用黑客工具包来不通过用户界面访问计算机，但这需要与计算机进行物理接触，或通过信息圈或相似的链接网络进行连接。

items.name: 激光手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把紧凑的手枪因可靠、耐用且价格实惠，成为协约世界（Pact Worlds）最受欢迎的随身武器。大多数普通激光手枪有轻质聚碳枪身，末端连着细长的枪管。

items.name: 半自动手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。

items.name: 商用型破片手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @Damage[1[bleed]]

These fragmentary grenades explode in a cloud of shrapnel and deal 1d8 piercing damage in a @Template[burst|distance:5] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击 @Damage[1[bleed]]

这类破片手雷爆炸时喷出大片弹片，造成1d8点穿刺伤害，范围为 @Template[burst|distance:5] 并进行 @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] 豁免。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 鼠人
items.expectedDescription: Once known as ratfolk, ysoki are clever and flexible. With roots on countless worlds, ysoki work alongside larger species, helping to establish communities and accomplish tough tasks. From the largest of crowds to the tightest of tunnels, a ysoki always knows how to find their way.
items.description: 鼠族曾被称为鼠人，聪明而灵活。他们扎根于无数世界，与体型更大的族群并肩工作，帮助建立社群、完成艰难的任务。从最拥挤的人群到最狭窄的隧道，鼠族总知道如何找到道路。

items.name: 尖牙
items.expectedDescription: Your prominent incisors offer an alternative to the fists other humanoids bring to a fight. You have a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the agile and finesse traits.
items.description: 你突出的尖锐门牙能成为如同拳头一般的战斗武器。你获得可以造成1d4穿刺伤害的颚无武装攻击。你的颚属于搏击武器组并且具有灵巧和娴熟特征。

items.name: 窄隧鼠人
items.expectedDescription: Your incredibly small bones allow you to easily compress your body and squeeze through gaps, whether it's the space between walls to reach a severed data cable or the ductwork of a space station. You gain the Quick Squeeze feat, even if you aren't trained in Acrobatics. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the Squeeze action aren't difficult terrain for you.
items.description: 你极其细小的骨骼使你能够轻松压缩身体、挤过缝隙，无论是钻入墙间修理断裂的数据线，还是穿行于空间站的管道中。你获得迅速穿行专长，即使你在特技上未受训。狭窄但尚不足以要求使用挤入动作的空间，对你而言不算困难地形。

items.name: 迅速挤入
items.expectedDescription: You Squeeze 5 feet per round (10 feet on a critical success). If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you Squeeze at full Speed.
items.description: 你每轮可以在挤入（Squeeze）狭窄空间时移动5尺（大成功10尺）。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到传奇，你可以在挤入狭窄空间时全速移动。

items.name: 城市油子
items.expectedDescription:
You've lived long enough in a major settlement to know how to keep your head down, avoid direct eye contact, and otherwise move about your day without drawing any attention to yourself. Whether you were a detective tailing a suspect or just lived in a crime-ridden neighborhood, you've always been able to slip into a crowd to avoid causing trouble.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill and a Lore skill about a specific settlement. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.N68CjcvYmLF35KrD] skill feat.
items.description:
你在一个大城市中生活得够久，知道如何保持低调，避免直接目光接触，并在日常生活中不引起任何注意。无论你是一个跟踪嫌疑犯的侦探，还是仅仅生活在一个犯罪猖獗的街区，你总能巧妙地融入人群，以避免惹麻烦。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是敏捷或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的欺骗技能和特定聚居地学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.N68CjcvYmLF35KrD]（Face in the Crowd）技能专长。

items.name: 混入人群
items.expectedDescription:
You know how to get lost in a crowd. You can use cover from crowds to Hide and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks when in a crowd of at least 10 creatures and a +4 circumstance bonus to your Stealth checks when in a crowd of at least 100 creatures. Hidden creatures don't count as members of a crowd. If you're a master in Deception you only need 5 creatures to get these bonuses.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.IaICLG7zwOV4OKgM]
items.description:
你知道如何在人群中消失。你可以利用人群的掩护进行躲藏和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]，当在至少10个生物的人群中时，你的隐秘检定获得+2环境加值，当在至少100个生物的人群中时，你的隐秘检定获得+4环境加值。藏匿的生物不计入人群数量。如果你在欺骗技能上有大师熟练，则只需要5个生物就能获得上述好处。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.IaICLG7zwOV4OKgM]

items.name: 织维巫师
items.expectedDescription: A strange paradoxical event forever altered your existence, and now you can manipulate reality. You explore the infinite possibilities of the multiverse, possibly visualizing variant timelines or parallel worlds. You create fields that subvert space and time, allowing you to cast powerful magic. You've learned to focus on an anchoring memory, concept, or object to help you identify reality.
items.description: 一场奇异的悖论事件永久改变了你的存在，如今你可以操纵现实。你探索多元宇宙的无限可能，或许还能看到不同的时间线或平行世界。你创造颠覆时空的场域，借此施展强大的魔法。你已学会专注于一段作为锚点的记忆、一个概念或一件物品，以帮助自己辨识现实。

items.name: 悖论
items.expectedDescription:
Your existence is contrary to the status quo of the universe, causing quantum ripples that empower your spellcasting talent and open doorways to other worlds. Perhaps you're from an alternate reality or a different timeline, or perhaps you experienced an unnatural phenomenon that altered your path, discovered a time-glitching alien device, or wrote a treatise on quantum magical theory. Whatever your story, you've become a living paradox.

At 1st level, choose your paradox. Your chosen paradox determines the tradition of your spells, additional trained skills, additional spells you learn, and the effects of your quantum field. You also gain Focus Points and special focus spells called warp spells based on your paradox.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.42tQJXhySw9QKcn6]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.hFIB6wlYGK93zl4g]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.1E12XmyqzIK1jXrY]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.cxBVbSITniNRwfMi]
items.description:
你的存在本质有别于当下的宇宙，这种异常激发的量子涟漪正是你施法能力的源泉，为你开启通往崭新世界的道路。你可能来自被覆写的现实或是不同的时间线，也可能你接触了足以改变你命运的现象，发现了干涉时间的异星设备，或是发表了一篇关于量子魔法论的论文。不论你经历如何，你已经成为了活着的悖论。

在1级，选择你的悖论，其决定了你的施法根源、学习的额外法术、额外的受训技能，以及你量子场域中的效应。你也会获得聚能点和被称为曲织法术（warp spell）的聚能法术，其基于你的悖论。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.42tQJXhySw9QKcn6]

items.name: 量子场域
items.expectedDescription:
You can draw on paradoxical forces to create a reality-warping quantum field. It might manifest as a haze in the air that shows shimmers of alternate realities, appear as walls of glowing magical equations, or any other display you choose. The effects of your quantum field are determined by your paradox. You can further enhance and manipulate your quantum field through your witchwarper feat selections and by casting warp spells. You can activate or extend the duration of your quantum field by using reality-warping magic.

You have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0] action, which lets you activate your quantum field. This action gains the arcane or occult trait based on the tradition of your selected paradox. You also have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.30Nw5q4vWKCQIBIZ], which lets you establish your quantum field quickly at the start of combat.
items.description:

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0]动作，其允许你激活你的量子场域。这一动作会根据你悖论决定的施法根源相应获得奥术或异能特征。此外，你还获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.30Nw5q4vWKCQIBIZ]动作，可以在遭遇开始时快速激活量子场域。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.
items.description:
秘术师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及来自你联结的额外法术和戏法。你从你联结对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术，或者从你获得许可的其他源自你魔法根源的法术中进行选择。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。当你获得新的法术环位时，你的第一个新法术总是对应环级的来自你联结的授予法术，然后你可以选择其他你获取的法术。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，可能会想替换之前学过的部分法术。每次你升级并学习新法术时，可以将一个旧法术替换为另一个同环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但你不能替换顿悟法术或联结法术。你也可以通过休整期重训替换法术。

织维巫师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及悖论赋予你的额外法术和戏法。你从你悖论对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，你可能会想要替换之前学习的一些法术。每次你获得新的等级学习新的法术时，你可以将一个旧法术置换为一个同一环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但是你不能替换悖论的授予法术。你也可以通过休整期重训来替换法术。

items.name: 织维巫师施法
items.expectedDescription:
Your paradox grants you magical power. You can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a witchwarper, when you cast spells, you might describe your revelations about other realities aloud, accompanied by elegant gestures while arcane equations or occult symbols blaze around you.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a witchwarper, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Charisma or Intelligence modifier, depending on which you chose for your key attribute.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witchwarper spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

Warp Spells

You can create powerful magical phenomena known as warp spells. Warp spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a warp spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to contemplate infinite worlds or conduct quantum magical research.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Warp spells have the anchoring trait, unlike other focus spells. This trait means you can only use warp spells while your quantum field is active, and you automatically Sustain your quantum field when you cast warp spells.

You learn warp spells based on your paradox.
items.description:
你的悖论赋予了你魔法力量。你可以用施放法术行动来施法。作为织维巫师，当你施法时，你可能会大声描述关于其他现实的启示，兼有优雅的手势，而神秘符号或者奥法方程在你身周闪烁。

你每日最多可以施放三个1环法术。在施放法术前你必须已知这些法术，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习法术。你每日可以施放的法术数量被称为法术位。

随着你织维巫师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如下表所示。

你的某些法术需要你尝试一次法术攻击掷骰来确认法术的起效程度，或是迫使你的敌人投骰来对抗法术DC（通常是尝试一次豁免骰）。你的法术攻击骰和法术DC取决于你选择的关键属性以智力或魅力作为调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整，这通常等于你拥有的织维巫师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级织维巫师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级织维巫师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

曲织法术

你可以创造被称为曲织法术的强大魔法现象。曲织法术是一种聚能法术。施放一个曲织法术需要花费1聚能点，而你初始拥有一个含有1聚能点的聚能池。每日准备期间，你会将聚能池补满；你也可以花费10分钟使用重新聚能活动，沉思无穷世界或进行量子魔法研究，以恢复1聚能点。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你的等级的一半，向上取整，类似戏法一般。聚能法术不需要法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。选取专长能够给予你更多聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，但你的聚能池拥有不能超过3点聚能点。

与其他聚能法术不同，曲织法术具有锚定特征。此特征意味着你只能在量子场域生效期间使用曲织法术，且施放曲织法术时，你会自动维持量子场域。

你学习的曲织法术基于你的悖论。

items.name: 修补匠之手
items.expectedDescription: You grew up learning to tinker with devices, repair objects, and take things apart. You're trained in Crafting. If you're trained in Crafting from another source (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 卡萨斯人
items.expectedDescription: Steeped in the ancient traditions of a distant home world orbiting a dying star, kasathas are four-armed humanoids who arrived in the Pact Worlds aboard a massive worldship named Idari. Striving for cosmic balance in all things, kasathas take pride in tempering their technological advances with the wisdom of their ancestors.
items.description: 卡萨斯人是四臂类人生物，深受遥远母星的古老传统熏陶。那颗母星围绕一颗垂死恒星运行，而他们乘坐名为伊达里号的巨型世界舰抵达了协约世界。卡萨斯人追求万事万物的宇宙平衡，并以祖先智慧调和科技进步为荣。

items.name: 四臂
items.expectedDescription: You have four arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
items.description: （卡萨斯人）

items.name: 舰生卡萨斯人
items.expectedDescription: You were one of the kasathas born and raised on the Idari worldship that now orbits the Pact Worlds' sun. Your family kept hope and tradition alive while enduring the hardships of lengthy space travel. For you, the Idari is the only home you've ever known. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
items.description: 你是在伊达里号上出生并成长的卡萨斯人中的一员，这艘世界舰如今正运行在协约世界的恒星轨道上。你的家族在漫长且艰辛的星际旅行中始终坚守着希望与传统。对你而言，伊达里号是你唯一熟知的家园。当你在一次对抗情绪效果的豁免检定上掷骰出成功时，你改为获得大成功结果。

items.name: 太空旅者
items.expectedDescription:
Some people might say you've been out in the Drift too long, but the truth is, you don't feel at home away from your post on a starship deck. You might crew a long-haul freighter, military gunship, or tourist shuttle. Truth is, you'd probably sign up for any job that took you off-world.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Piloting skill and the Drift Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.K2R1xGTgBnSCDMUl]{Express Driver} skill feat.
items.description:
有些人可能会说你在漂流域中度过的时间太长了，但事实上，你早已无法适应远离星舰甲板的生活。无论是长途货运飞船、军用炮艇，还是观光穿梭机——只要能让你离开行星，你大概会毫不犹豫地签下任何工作合约。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是敏捷或体质，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的驾驶技能和漂流域学识（Drift Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.K2R1xGTgBnSCDMUl]（Express Driver）技能专长。

items.name: 特快司机
items.expectedDescription: You know how to get there fast. When calculating your travel Speed for the day while piloting a vehicle, you can attempt a Piloting check to increase your vehicle's travel Speed for long-term overland or aerial travel. The DC is determined by the GM but is typically based on the vehicle's piloting DC or a difficulty based on the environment, whichever is harder. On a success, double your vehicle's travel Speed for the day. This has no effect on your vehicle's movement in encounters or on starships traveling through the Drift.
items.description: 你懂得如何迅速抵达目的地。驾驶载具并计算当天的旅行速度时，你可以尝试驾驶检定，提高载具在长期陆路或空中旅行时的旅行速度。DC由GM决定，通常采用载具驾驶DC或基于环境的难度，取较高者。成功时，载具当天的旅行速度翻倍。这不影响载具在遭遇中的移动，也不影响通过漂流域航行的星舰。

items.name: 特工
items.expectedDescription: You're a focused, quick-witted professional who thrives in high-stakes combat. Your deadly aim and tactical training give you an edge over the competition—for you, even the most powerful enemy is just another mark to take out. You have impressive prowess in your chosen field of specialization.
items.description: 你是专注而机敏的专业人士，在生死攸关的战斗中如鱼得水。致命的瞄准技巧与战术训练使你在较量中占优——对你而言，即使最强大的敌人也只是另一个需要解决的目标。你在自己选择的专精领域中拥有非凡的造诣。

items.name: 神射手

items.name: 瞄准
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait.

You take careful aim at a single creature that you're aware of, designating it as your mark until your next turn. Your ranged Strikes against your mark using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 1. These benefits only apply if your mark is within your weapon's first range increment. You can only have one mark at a time.

As your operative level increases, so does your ability to Aim. Increase the number of dice for the precision damage by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels. At 11th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 2 rather than 1. At 17th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 4 rather than 2.
items.description:
需求 你持用一把不带有区域特征的远程武器。

你仔细瞄准一个你能感知到的生物，直到你的下一回合前将其指定为你的标靶。你使用需求的远程武器对标靶生物进行的远程打击会造成额外1d4精准伤害，并将你标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低1。这些增益只会在标靶处于你武器的第一射程增量内时有效。你同一时间只能有一个标靶。

随着你的特工等级提升，你的瞄准技巧也得到改进。在5、11、17级时，精准伤害的伤害骰增加一个。11级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低2而非1。17级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低4而非2。

items.name: 渗透者
items.expectedDescription:
You specialize in bypassing security systems, hazards, traps, and other defenses. From hacking a computer system or cutting power to a building, to bypassing a biometric lock and cracking a secure vault, you're skilled at accessing locations without alerting security or tripping safeguards. You're trained in Computers. You gain a skill feat for Computers.

Exploit: Your tinkering causes technological items and creatures to experience glitches and malfunctions. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.qbyer2woEdGXZzoR] action.

Enhanced Exploit: You can Sabotage as a free action whenever you critically hit a tech creature with a melee or ranged attack, targeting the triggering creature. You can Sabotage as a reaction whenever a tech creature or a creature using a tech weapon critically fails a melee attack roll against you, targeting the triggering creature or weapon.
items.description:
你擅长绕过安全系统、危害、陷阱和其他防御措施。你掌握了在不触发安全措施和警报的情况下进入位置的技能，从黑入计算机系统、切断建筑电源，到绕过生物识别锁并破解保险库。你在计算机上受训，并获得一个计算机技能专长。

秘技：你的小把戏能使科技设备和科技生物出现故障和失灵。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.qbyer2woEdGXZzoR]动作。

进阶秘技：当你用近战攻击或远程攻击对科技生物造成重击时，能够以自由动作对触发生物使用破坏。你还可以在科技生物或使用科技武器的生物对你进行近战攻击大失败时，以反应动作对触发生物或武器使用破坏。

items.name: 破坏
items.expectedDescription:
You disrupt enemy tech to cover your tracks or gain a tactical advantage. Select a single tech creature or tech item within 15 feet that you can detect. If your target is a tech creature, attempt a @Check[computers|against:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. If your target is a tech item, attempt a Computers check against the item's DC or the @Check[computers|against:reflex]{Reflex DC} of the creature possessing the item if the item is being carried, held, or worn.

If you're an expert in Computers, you can Sabotage a tech creature or tech item within 30 feet. If you're a master, this range increases to 45 feet. If you're legendary, this range increases to 60 feet.

Critical Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} for 1 minute.

Success The target becomes glitching 1 for 2 rounds.

Failure Your attempt fails and requires more persistent analysis. The target is immune to your Sabotage until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure Your attempt backfires. The target is immune to your Sabotage for 10 minutes.
items.description:
你干扰敌方科技，以掩盖踪迹或获得战术优势。选择15尺内一个你能侦测到的科技生物或科技物品。如果目标是科技生物，进行一次@Check[computers|against:fortitude]检定，对抗该生物的强韧DC。如果目标是科技物品，进行计算机检定，对抗物品的DC；如果物品正被携带、持握或穿戴，则改为对抗其持有者的@Check[computers|against:reflex]{反射DC}。

计算机为专家熟练度时，你可以破坏30尺内的科技生物或科技物品。大师熟练度时，此范围增加至45尺；传奇熟练度时，增加至60尺。

大成功目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}，持续1分钟。

成功目标陷入故障1，持续2轮。

失败你的尝试失败，需要进一步持续分析。目标免疫你的破坏，直到你的下个回合结束。

大失败你的尝试适得其反。目标免疫你的破坏10分钟。

You have an almost supernatural control of your movements, which can sometimes save you in dangerous situations. You can reroll the triggering skill check or saving throw, using the second result even if it's worse.
items.description:
频率每日一次
