items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 维斯克蜥人
items.expectedDescription: Vesk are a warmongering, reptilian people who conquered the eight worlds in their solar system shortly after they developed spaceflight, forming the Veskarium empire. Vesk tend to embrace conflict and respect strength and military might.
items.description: 维斯克是好战的爬行类种族，在发展出太空航行技术后不久，便征服了自己恒星系中的八个世界，建立维斯卡里姆帝国。维斯克倾向于拥抱冲突，尊重力量和军事威势。

items.name: 夜行维斯客蜥人
items.expectedDescription: You've adapted to live in darkness, perhaps due to living underground, in dim starship corridors, under smoke-shrouded skies, or on a planet far from its sun. You gain darkvision.
items.description: 你已经适应了在黑暗中的生活，也许是由于生活在地下，在灯光昏暗的星舰走廊中，在烟雾笼罩的天空下， 或是在远离太阳的行星上。你获得黑暗视觉。

items.name: 法外狂徒
items.expectedDescription:
You're a career criminal with a nasty reputation. Perhaps unfair circumstances forced you into a life of crime, or maybe you enjoy the thrill you get from pulling off a heist or living through a shoot-out. Either way, this life is the only one you know, and thanks to the bounty on your head, you're in it until the casket drops or you make enough creds to buy a new one.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.zdycsO9Z0wHBZ17k] skill feat.
items.description:
你是一个声名狼藉的职业罪犯。也许是不公平的环境迫使你走上了犯罪生涯，或者你享受从抢劫中获得的刺激感或经历火拼的快感。无论如何，你只熟悉这种生活——而悬赏令的存在，更让你注定无法脱身，要么横死街头，要么赚够钱买条新命。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是力量或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的威吓技能和黑道学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.zdycsO9Z0wHBZ17k]（Intimidating Shot）技能专长。

items.name: 威吓射击
items.expectedDescription: You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe with your ranged weapon by firing it into the air, using ammo equal to the weapon's expend and the weapon's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take a –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.
items.description: 你尝试通过向空中开枪来对一个在你远程武器射程内的敌人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]，使用的弹药数量等于武器的耗弹量，使用武器的最大射程替代挫败士气通常的30尺范围。即便目标与你语言不通，此检定也不会受到-4环境减值。

items.name: 恒星武士
items.expectedDescription: You're a conduit for the stellar forces of the cosmos—a solar knight. The powers of gravity and light represent the extremes of these forces, and you can attune yourself between them. As an agent of this cycle, you manifest an array of solar equipment and use your own connection to stellar forces to empower them. Regardless of which extreme of the stellar spectrum you prefer, you can change your attunement between them to take advantage of solar powers earned through meditation and practice.
items.description: 你是传导宇宙星辰之力的媒介——一名恒星骑士。引力与光代表这些力量的两极，而你可以在二者之间调整自身的调谐。作为这一循环的代行者，你显现出一系列恒星武装，并利用自身与星辰之力的联系来强化它们。无论你偏爱恒星光谱的哪一极，你都可以在二者之间改变调谐，运用通过冥想和练习获得的恒星之力。

items.name: 恒星显象
items.expectedDescription:
Your deep understanding of the stellar forces of the universe manifests in a variety of tangible ways. You can create and maintain three different manifestations: a solar flare, solar nimbus, and solar weapon. Your manifestations temporarily vanish if you become unattuned.

Solar Flare

A small mote of solar power hovers nearby or appears embedded on some part of your body, such as the palm of your hand or on your face. This mote can unleash a directed blast of energy at short range. Your solar flare is a martial ranged weapon in the brawling weapon group with the attuned and solarian traits. It doesn't take up a hand and doesn't need to be held to be wielded. Your solar flare can't be targeted by other creatures or removed from your person, except for when you become unattuned. Your attunement determines the damage type and range increment of your solar flare. You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare. You can improve the damage of your solar flare with solarian crystals.

Graviton-Attuned 1d8 bludgeoning, range increment 15 feet. On a critical success, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target as a free action, ignoring range and multiple attack penalty, even if you don't have a free hand.

Photon-Attuned 1d6 fire, range increment 30 feet. On a critical success, the target additionally takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Solar Nimbus

A layer of stellar energy surrounds you, overlaying your body or worn armor. It appears as a layer of glowing light or solid darkness, depending on your current state of attunement. The general appearance and shape of the nimbus is your choice and could appear as a lattice of energy surrounding you or imposing spiked energy armor layered atop your existing equipment. This design has no impact on its function and doesn't provide any additional bonuses.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm] reaction.

Solar Weapon

Through sheer will, you call forth a tangible weapon forged from the essence of stars. This weapon is an extension of yourself, and you can change its form with meditation. When manifesting your weapon, it appears in a free hand of your choice. If it has the free-hand trait, it can manifest in any hand. Your solar weapon is a martial melee weapon. It deals 1d8 of your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with the attuned and solarian traits.

At first level, choose up to two of the following traits for your weapon. Alternatively, you can select the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait for your weapon instead of selecting two of the following traits.

  • Disarm
  • Free-Hand
  • Grapple
  • Nonlethal
  • Parry
  • Shove
  • Sweep
  • Trip
  • Versatile (B/P/S only)
  • Reach (counts as two traits)
  • Two-Hand 1d10 (counts as two traits)

You can select one of the following weapon groups for your weapon to be a part of.

  • Axe
  • Brawling
  • Club
  • Flail
  • Hammer
  • Knife
  • Pick
  • Polearm
  • Spear
  • Sword

Your solar weapon gains additional benefits based on your current attunement.

Graviton-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature using your solar weapon, that creature's space and all squares adjacent to it are difficult terrain for that creature until the end of its next turn.

Photon-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature with your solar weapon, you deal an additional amount of fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up). Your solar weapon casts bright light in a 5-foot radius (and dim light for the next 5 feet).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]
items.description:
你对宇宙中的星辰之力的深刻理解能够通过具象的形式显现出来。你可以创造并维持所有三种不同的现象恒星显象：恒星耀斑，恒星光晕亦或是恒星武器。当你变为未调谐时，你的恒星显象会暂时消失。

恒星耀斑

一粒微小的恒星能量微粒悬浮在你身边，或沁入在你身体个部位，例如手或脸。这粒微粒能在短距离内释放定向能量冲击。你的恒星耀斑是一件搏击武器组的军用远程武器，具有调谐与恒星武士特征。它不占手，无需持握或持用。其他生物无法以你的恒星耀斑为目标，也无法将其从你身上移除，除了你变为未调谐状态。你的调谐状态决定你恒星耀斑的伤害类型与射程增量。你可将力量调整值加到你恒星耀斑的伤害掷骰上。你可以使用恒星武士水晶来提升恒星耀斑的伤害。

引力子调谐1d8钝击，射程增量15尺。重击时，你可以用自由动作尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]目标，忽略射程与多重攻击减值，即便你没有空手。

光量子调谐1d6火焰，射程增量30尺。重击时，目标额外受到1d6点持续火焰伤害。

恒星光晕

一层星辰能量环绕着你，复盖在你的躯体或穿戴的护甲之上。它呈现为一层散发的亮光或凝固的暗影，取决于你当前的调谐状态。光晕的整体外观与形态可由你自由选择，既可化作环绕周身的能量网格，亦可化作覆盖现有装备的带尖能量护甲。此类设计不影响其功能，亦不提供额外加成。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm]反应动作。

恒星武器

凭着纯粹的意志，你召唤出一把由星辰本源锻造的有形武器。此武器是你自身的延伸，可通过冥想改变其形态。当显化武器时，它会出现在你选择的空手中。如果该武器具有不占手特征，则可显化于任意手中。你的恒星武器是一件军用近战武器。它能根据你的选择造成1d8点钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，并具有调谐和恒星武士特征。

第一级时，为你的武器选择至多两项下列特征。或者，你可以为你的武器选择长触及或双手1d10特征替代选择两项下列特征。

  • 卸武
  • 不占手
  • 擒拿
  • 非致命
  • 格挡
  • 推撞
  • 横扫
  • 摔绊
  • 多用（仅限B/P/S）
  • 长触及（算作两项特征）
  • 双手1d10（算作两项特征）

你可以选择你的武器属于以下哪一个武器组。

  • 斧
  • 搏击
  • 棍棒
  • 连枷
  • 锤
  • 短刃
  • 镐
  • 长武
  • 矛
  • 剑

你的恒星武器根据你当前的调谐状态获得额外增益。

引力子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，该生物所处空间以及所有与它相邻的方格，对该生物变为困难地形，直至其下个回合结束。

光量子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，你额外造成等同于你等级一半的火焰伤害（向上取整）。你的恒星武器在5尺半径内散发出明亮光照（在此后5尺内散发昏暗光照）。

items.name: 星辰调谐
items.expectedDescription:
As a solarian, your existence cycles between the aspects of stars. You begin with two aspects: photon (the power of stars to emit heat, light, and plasma) and graviton (the power of stars to attract and imprison objects through gravity). At any time, you're considered graviton-attuned, photon-attuned, or unattuned. Many of your abilities have additional effects based on your current attunement, and some abilities swap your current state of attunement to another state.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] action.
items.description:
作为一名恒星武士，星辰面相间的循环决定了你的存在。你初始拥有两种面相：光量子（photon，星辰散发出热量、光以及等离子体的力量）或引力子（graviton，星辰通过引力吸引和束缚物体的力量）。在任何情况下，你都处在引力子调谐、光量子调谐、或未调谐三种情况之一。你的许多能力都会根据你的当前调谐产生额外的效果，而有些能力则会将你的当前调谐转变成另一种情况。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]动作。

items.name: 光晕涌动
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your nimbus surges with energy, forcing an opening in your foe's defenses. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Graviton-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its turn.

Photon-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its turn.
items.description:
触发 你触及范围内的一个生物使用操作或移动动作，进行远程攻击，或者使用移动动作时离开一个方格。

你的光晕迸发能量，强行撕开敌人的防御。对触发生物进行一次近战打击。这次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值，你的多重攻击减值也不应用于此次打击。

引力子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到其回合结束。

光量子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，直到其回合开始。

items.name: 重铸恒星武器
items.expectedDescription:
You spend 10 minutes focusing on the composition of your solar weapon. You can change your solar weapon's damage type (typically choosing between bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing), selected traits, and weapon group. Your weapon maintains your selections until the next time you Re-Forge Solar Weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]
items.description:
你花费10分钟的时间专注于调整你恒星武器的构造。你可以更改武器的伤害类型（通常情况下在钝击、穿刺或挥砍之中选择），所选的武器特征，以及所属的武器组。恒星武器会始终保留你的选择，直至你下一次重铸恒星武器。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

items.name: 调和
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

You steady your body and mind and attune yourself to the stellar aspect of your choice. You become attuned to photon or graviton. You can also manifest any of your solar manifestations if they're currently dormant and if you have the free hands to use them.

Special In addition to the above usage, you can also Attune as a free action when you roll initiative.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

稳定身心，与所选的星辰面相调谐一致。你变得与光量子或引力子调谐。你可以也选择显现你的恒星显象，只要它们当前处于休眠状态，且你有一只空手来使用它们。

特殊 除了上述用法外，你可以在掷骰先攻时，以自由动作使用调和。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

items.name: 无所畏惧
items.expectedDescription: Whether it comes from a sense of duty or a desire to succeed, you rarely flinch when confronted by fearsome foes. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.
items.description: 无论是出于使命感，还是对成功的渴望，当你面对广阔宇宙的恐怖时你鲜有退缩，并能用你的力量激励你的盟友。如果你在对抗恐惧效果的豁免骰掷出成功结果时，你改为获得大成功。

items.name: 恒星护盾
items.expectedDescription:
You've developed a new solar manifestation—a small shield of stellar energy that orbits you. This energy shield has the attuned and solarian traits and doesn't require a hand to use. You can Raise a Shield, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You gain the Shield Block general feat.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.q5W7fV1wXvqBFxt8]

While the shield is raised, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your shield. The shield has Hit Points equal to 5 plus twice your level and Hardness equal to half your level, rounded up. Your shield can't be broken, but if it's destroyed, you can't manifest a new shield for 10 minutes. If your shield vanishes due to you losing attunement, when you Attune to reform it, the shield returns with however many Hit Points it previously had. The shield regains all its lost Hit Points during your daily preparations and whenever you rest for at least 10 minutes, even if it's been destroyed.

Graviton-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a shock wave. Adjacent enemies must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure).

Photon-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a flash of light. items.description:
你开发出一种新的恒星显象——一个环绕你旋转的星辰能量小护盾。该能量护盾具有调谐和恒星武士特征，不需要手来使用。你可以举起盾牌，在AC上获得+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始。你获得盾牌格挡通用专长。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 奇植族
items.expectedDescription: Khizars are intelligent plants who live in harmony with nature and have learned to communicate telepathically with other creatures.
items.description: 奇植族是与自然和谐共处的智慧植物，已学会与其他生物以心灵感应交流。

items.name: 有限心灵感应
items.expectedDescription: You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
items.description: 你可以与30尺内的生物以心灵交流，但只能与和你具有共同语言的生物交流。这不会让你读取它们的思想，传递的信息也不会多于普通言语所能表达的内容。

items.name: 植性
items.expectedDescription: You receive a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects, paralysis, poison, or sleep. You don't need to eat, drink, or sleep if you're exposed to natural sunlight for at least 4 hours per day.
items.description: 你在对抗心灵，麻痹，毒素或睡眠效果的豁免上获得+1环境加值。如果你每天暴露在自然阳光下至少4小时，则你不需要进食，饮水，或睡眠。

items.name: 隐居者
items.expectedDescription:
You used to be someone, but that was in another life. You keep to yourself these days, eking out an existence as a hermit in the wilderness or a loner in a rundown neighborhood. You thought you put your past behind you, until a new disciple or an old enemy dragged you back into a life of adventure.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill and a Lore skill related to your former life. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat.
items.description:
你曾是个有头有脸的人物，但那已是前世之事。如今你离群索居，要么在荒野中当个隐士，要么在破败街区做个独行客。原以为往事早已翻篇，却未料——新收的门徒或宿敌，又将你拽回了冒险生涯。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是体质或感知，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的生存技能和与你过去职业相关的学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]（Dubious Knowledge）技能专长。

items.name: 可疑知识
items.expectedDescription: You're a treasure trove of information, but not all of it comes from reputable sources. When you fail (but don't critically fail) a Recall Knowledge check using any skill, you learn the correct answer and an erroneous answer, but you don't have any way to differentiate which is which. This can occur as knowing something is significant, but not whether it's good or bad.
items.description: 你是信息的宝库，但它们的来源并非全都可靠。当你使用任何技能进行的回忆知识检定失败（但没有大失败）时，你会得到一个正确的答案和一个错误的答案，但你不会知道哪个是正确的。也可能是知道某件事情非常重要，但不知道它是好是坏。

extraFields.expected: trained in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action
extraFields.text: 一项具有回忆知识动作的技能受训

items.name: 繁花
items.expectedDescription: You draw from a wellspring of vital energy to remain constantly in bloom. Choose one cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SnjhtQYexDtNDdEg]{Stabilize} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash}, which you can cast as a primal innate spell at will. This choice can't be changed. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against void effects.
items.description: 你能汲取源源不断的生命能量，保持活力绽放。选择一个戏法：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SnjhtQYexDtNDdEg]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]，你可以将其以原能内在法术的形式随意施放。该选择不可更改。戏法被升阶至你等级的一半，向上取整。你还会在对抗虚能效果时豁免上获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 士兵
items.expectedDescription: You're a master of area weapons, heavy armor, and soaking damage. You fight in the thick of the battle and unleash devastating salvos against your foes as you take withering fire in return. By laying down a barrage of suppressing fire with powerful weapons, you set your allies up to fulfill their respective roles while encouraging enemies to focus on you.
items.description: 你精通区域武器和重甲，也擅长承受伤害。你奋战在战斗最激烈的地方，向敌人倾泻毁灭性的齐射，同时承受对方猛烈的还击。你以强大的武器铺设压制火力，吸引敌人将注意力集中在自己身上，为盟友各司其职创造条件。

items.name: 士兵战斗风格
items.expectedDescription:
As a soldier, you train using a specific style of fighting. Your style determines how you approach combat and often changes how you take advantage of your ability to suppress targets. Choose a soldier fighting style.

items.name: 激昂英姿
items.expectedDescription:
You believe that anything can be solved by shooting your way out. Somehow, your bravado and over-the-top actions have a way of working out for you, despite logic often suggesting otherwise. To you, there's no problem that a barrage of bullets or laser blasts can't fix. You've become a specialist at dealing out devastation with automatic weapons, whether you're fighting on the front line, operating a turret in a speeding vehicle, or blasting through a crowd of enemies.

When you successfully make a ranged Strike with an automatic weapon, you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]{Suppress} the target until the start of your next turn. In addition, when you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg], the size of the cone is equal to the weapon's full range increment, rather than half. When using the Auto-Fire action, you can designate a target anywhere in the cone to be your primary target, rather than the creature closest to you.
items.description:
你坚信一切问题都可以通过火力扫除障碍来解决。你莽撞的选择和夸张的声势会为你杀出血路，尽管并非明智之举。对你来说，没有什么问题是不能被足量子弹或者激光喷射解决的，当然你也可以将它们混合或者寻找其他手段，如果需要的话。你已经专精于运用自动武器，无论是在前线作战，操纵疾驰载具上的炮塔，抑或是在敌群中开火扫荡。

当你使用具有全自动特征的武器成功进行一次远程打击时，你会@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]目标，直到你的下个回合开始。除此之外，当你使用@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]时，锥形区域的范围等同于武器的射程增量，而非一半。当使用自动射击时，你可以指定在锥形区域内任何位置的目标作为主目标，而不局限于距离你最近的目标。

items.name: 移动军械库
items.expectedDescription:
Your endurance training empowers you to carry a load of heavy equipment. When determining your Strength for using armor, you can instead choose to use your Constitution modifier. If you already meet the Strength requirement for the armor you're wearing, reduce that armor's Bulk by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

In addition, increase the amount of Bulk you can carry before becoming encumbered by half your Constitution modifier rounded up. Increase your maximum carried Bulk by your Constitution modifier.
items.description:
你的耐力训练使你能够携带大量重型装备。判定你穿戴护甲所用的力量时，你可以改用体质调整值。如果你已经达到了护甲的力量需求，你能将该护甲的负载减少1（最小为1）。

此外，你判定超载的负载上限增加你体质调整值的一半（向上取整）。你的最大负载上限增加你体质调整值。

items.name: 压制火力
items.expectedDescription: You have a knack for using powerful weapons to harry your foes and hinder their movement, preventing them from operating at their peak. When you make an attack with the area trait (such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]), you use it in a manner that suppresses your targets. Enemies in the affected area who fail their save against your attack become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until the start of your next turn. A suppressed target takes a –1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds. Some soldier abilities and class feats interact further with the suppressed condition.
items.description: 你懂得如何使用强大的武器来阻碍敌人，并遏阻他们以全盛姿态行动。当你进行一次具有区域特征的攻击（例如来自@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]动作），你将以压制目标的方式来运用它。受影响区域内的生物如果没有成功通对你攻击的豁免，便会陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]状态，直到你的下个回合开始。被压制的目标在攻击骰上有-1环境减值，在速度上有-10尺状态减值。有些士兵能力和职业专长会和被压制状态产生进一步交互。

items.name: 主目标
items.expectedDescription: You can focus fire on a single target when unleashing the full devastation of your powerful area weaponry. Before you make an area attack with a weapon (such as from the Area Fire or Auto-Fire actions), you can make a ranged Strike as a free action with the same weapon against a single creature in the area, who's selected as your primary target. If your attack is a burst, you must select the creature closest to the center of the attack. If your attack is a cone or line, you must select the creature closest to you. If two or more creatures are equidistant, you can choose which one is your primary target. On a hit, if your primary target rolls a success against your Area Fire or Auto-Fire action, they get a failure instead. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.
items.description: 当你完全倾泻手中强大武装的毁灭性火力时，你可以对一个目标制造尤为强大的火力。当你进行一次具有区域效果的攻击前（例如区域射击或自动射击动作），你可以以自由动作以相同的武器对区域中单个生物进行一次远程打击，将其作为你的主目标。如果你的攻击是爆发，你必须选择最接近攻击中心的生物。如果你的攻击为锥形或线形，你必须选择最接近你的生物。如果两个或两个以上的生物距离相等或最近，你可以选择其中一个作为你的主目标。如果你使用此次打击成功命中你的主目标，且目标对你的区域射击或自动射击掷骰出成功结果，其改为获得失败结果。此次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值。

items.name: 坚固藤蔓
items.expectedDescription: You've grown a stout vine that you can use to bludgeon enemies. You gain a vine unarmed attack, which is in the brawling weapon group, deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage, and has the khizar, sweep, trip, and unarmed traits.
items.description: 你长出了一根粗壮的藤蔓，可以用来钝击敌人。你获得藤蔓无武装攻击，它属于搏击武器组，造成1d6钝击伤害，并具有奇植族，横扫，摔绊与无武装特征。

items.name: 力量迸发
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.

You draw on your inner reserves and rally yourself to try again. Reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.
items.description:
频率每小时一次

触发你为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{擒拿}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{摔绊}进行的运动检定失败。

你重振内在的力量，让自己重振精神，再次尝试。你可以重骰触发检定，必须使用新的结果，即便其更差。

items.name: 龙人
items.expectedDescription:
Draconic in appearance and fiercely loyal, dragonkin are deeply empathic beings capable of forming a nearly unbreakable spiritual bond with one other creature, which manifests in telepathic communication and tactical synergy.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.EybiktinX2zD2k45]{Dragonkin}
items.description:
龙人外形似龙，忠诚无比，共情能力极强，能与另一个生物建立几乎无法打破的心灵纽带。这种纽带体现为心灵感应交流与战术上的协同配合。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.EybiktinX2zD2k45]{龙人}

items.name: 伴侣纽带
items.expectedDescription: You can form a permanent empathic bond with one willing sapient creature—usually a non-dragonkin. Forming this bond is a one-hour activity that can only be attempted if both you and your partner share a deep emotional bond. You and your partner must remain within reach of each other for the duration of this activity for it to succeed. Once this bond is formed, you can't form another partner bond unless your current partner dies. You and your partner can communicate with each other mentally, as if you had limited telepathy with a range of 60 feet.
items.description: 你可以与一位自愿的智慧生物（通常为非龙类）建立永久的共情纽带。建立此纽带需要一小时，且只有你和你的伴侣之间拥有深厚的情感纽带才能尝试。你和你的伴侣必须在此活动期间保持彼此触手可及的距离才能成功。一旦建立此纽带，除非你当前的伴侣死亡，否则你将无法再建立伴侣纽带。你和你的伴侣可以进行精神交流，如同你们拥有60尺范围的有限心灵感应能力。

items.name: 焰心龙人
items.expectedDescription: The embers burning in your blood keep you safe from the chill of high altitudes. You gain resistance to cold equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
items.description: 你血液中燃烧的余烬使你免受高海拔寒冷的侵袭。你获得相当于你等级一半（最低为1）的寒冷抗力。你受到寒冷气候的影响会降低一级（酷寒变为极寒，极寒变为严寒，以此类推）。

items.name: 运动员
items.expectedDescription:
You've strengthened your body through practice drills and workouts, making sure not to waste a single drop of sweat in your quest for gains. You might be a champion fighting in arena matches, a hardcore gym rat, or a heavy hitter on a competitive sports team—what matters to you is the rush you get when you beat a personal record.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Sports Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.Wc26O3XFKxWfxY5N] skill feat.
items.description:
你通过练习和锻炼强化了自己的身体，确保在追求进步的过程中不浪费一滴汗水。你可能是竞技场冠军选手，或者是一个疯狂健身的健身爱好者，亦或是在竞争激烈的体育团队中表现突出的重击手——对你来说，打破个人记录所带来的快感才是最重要的。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是力量或敏捷，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的运动技能和体育学识（Sports Lore）技能受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.Wc26O3XFKxWfxY5N]（Deadlift）技能专长。

items.name: 硬举
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

For 1 minute, you can carry 4 more Bulk than normal before becoming encumbered. The amount you can carry increases to 6 at expert, 8 at master, and 10 at legendary. When the benefits of this feat end, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 10 minutes.
items.description:
需求你没有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]状态

在1分钟内，你可以携带比正常多4B的物品而不受超载影响。额外的负载在运动专家时提升至6，大师时提升至8，传奇时提升至10。当此专长带来的好处结束时，你陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]10分钟。

items.name: 恒星武士
items.expectedDescription:
You're a conduit for the stellar forces of the cosmos—a solar knight. The powers of gravity and light represent the extremes of these forces, and you can attune yourself between them. As an agent of this cycle, you manifest an array of solar equipment and use your own connection to stellar forces to empower them. Regardless of which extreme of the stellar spectrum you prefer, you can change your attunement between them to take advantage of solar powers earned through meditation and practice.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.Nb6sw1oNTFwVPlLu]{Solarian}
items.description:
你是传导宇宙星辰之力的媒介——一名恒星骑士。引力与光代表这些力量的两极，而你可以在二者之间调整自身的调谐。作为这一循环的代行者，你显现出一系列恒星武装，并利用自身与星辰之力的联系来强化它们。无论你偏爱恒星光谱的哪一极，你都可以在二者之间改变调谐，运用通过冥想和练习获得的恒星之力。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.Nb6sw1oNTFwVPlLu]{恒星武士}

items.name: 恒星显象
items.expectedDescription:
Your deep understanding of the stellar forces of the universe manifests in a variety of tangible ways. You can create and maintain three different manifestations: a solar flare, solar nimbus, and solar weapon. Your manifestations temporarily vanish if you become unattuned.

Solar Flare

A small mote of solar power hovers nearby or appears embedded on some part of your body, such as the palm of your hand or on your face. This mote can unleash a directed blast of energy at short range. Your solar flare is a martial ranged weapon in the brawling weapon group with the attuned and solarian traits. It doesn't take up a hand and doesn't need to be held to be wielded. Your solar flare can't be targeted by other creatures or removed from your person, except for when you become unattuned. Your attunement determines the damage type and range increment of your solar flare. You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare. You can improve the damage of your solar flare with solarian crystals.

Graviton-Attuned 1d8 bludgeoning, range increment 15 feet. On a critical success, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target as a free action, ignoring range and multiple attack penalty, even if you don't have a free hand.

Photon-Attuned 1d6 fire, range increment 30 feet. On a critical success, the target additionally takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Solar Nimbus

A layer of stellar energy surrounds you, overlaying your body or worn armor. It appears as a layer of glowing light or solid darkness, depending on your current state of attunement. The general appearance and shape of the nimbus is your choice and could appear as a lattice of energy surrounding you or imposing spiked energy armor layered atop your existing equipment. This design has no impact on its function and doesn't provide any additional bonuses.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm] reaction.

Solar Weapon

Through sheer will, you call forth a tangible weapon forged from the essence of stars. This weapon is an extension of yourself, and you can change its form with meditation. When manifesting your weapon, it appears in a free hand of your choice. If it has the free-hand trait, it can manifest in any hand. Your solar weapon is a martial melee weapon. It deals 1d8 of your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with the attuned and solarian traits.

At first level, choose up to two of the following traits for your weapon. Alternatively, you can select the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait for your weapon instead of selecting two of the following traits.

  • Disarm
  • Free-Hand
  • Grapple
  • Nonlethal
  • Parry
  • Shove
  • Sweep
  • Trip
  • Versatile (B/P/S only)
  • Reach (counts as two traits)
  • Two-Hand 1d10 (counts as two traits)

You can select one of the following weapon groups for your weapon to be a part of.

  • Axe
  • Brawling
  • Club
  • Flail
  • Hammer
  • Knife
  • Pick
  • Polearm
  • Spear
  • Sword

Your solar weapon gains additional benefits based on your current attunement.

Graviton-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature using your solar weapon, that creature's space and all squares adjacent to it are difficult terrain for that creature until the end of its next turn.

Photon-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature with your solar weapon, you deal an additional amount of fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up). Your solar weapon casts bright light in a 5-foot radius (and dim light for the next 5 feet).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]
items.description:
你对宇宙中的星辰之力的深刻理解能够通过具象的形式显现出来。你可以创造并维持所有三种不同的现象恒星显象：恒星耀斑，恒星光晕亦或是恒星武器。当你变为未调谐时，你的恒星显象会暂时消失。

恒星耀斑

一粒微小的恒星能量微粒悬浮在你身边，或沁入在你身体个部位，例如手或脸。这粒微粒能在短距离内释放定向能量冲击。你的恒星耀斑是一件搏击武器组的军用远程武器，具有调谐与恒星武士特征。它不占手，无需持握或持用。其他生物无法以你的恒星耀斑为目标，也无法将其从你身上移除，除了你变为未调谐状态。你的调谐状态决定你恒星耀斑的伤害类型与射程增量。你可将力量调整值加到你恒星耀斑的伤害掷骰上。你可以使用恒星武士水晶来提升恒星耀斑的伤害。

引力子调谐1d8钝击，射程增量15尺。重击时，你可以用自由动作尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]目标，忽略射程与多重攻击减值，即便你没有空手。

光量子调谐1d6火焰，射程增量30尺。重击时，目标额外受到1d6点持续火焰伤害。

恒星光晕

一层星辰能量环绕着你，复盖在你的躯体或穿戴的护甲之上。它呈现为一层散发的亮光或凝固的暗影，取决于你当前的调谐状态。光晕的整体外观与形态可由你自由选择，既可化作环绕周身的能量网格，亦可化作覆盖现有装备的带尖能量护甲。此类设计不影响其功能，亦不提供额外加成。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm]反应动作。

恒星武器

凭着纯粹的意志，你召唤出一把由星辰本源锻造的有形武器。此武器是你自身的延伸，可通过冥想改变其形态。当显化武器时，它会出现在你选择的空手中。如果该武器具有不占手特征，则可显化于任意手中。你的恒星武器是一件军用近战武器。它能根据你的选择造成1d8点钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，并具有调谐和恒星武士特征。

第一级时，为你的武器选择至多两项下列特征。或者，你可以为你的武器选择长触及或双手1d10特征替代选择两项下列特征。

  • 卸武
  • 不占手
  • 擒拿
  • 非致命
  • 格挡
  • 推撞
  • 横扫
  • 摔绊
  • 多用（仅限B/P/S）
  • 长触及（算作两项特征）
  • 双手1d10（算作两项特征）

你可以选择你的武器属于以下哪一个武器组。

  • 斧
  • 搏击
  • 棍棒
  • 连枷
  • 锤
  • 短刃
  • 镐
  • 长武
  • 矛
  • 剑

你的恒星武器根据你当前的调谐状态获得额外增益。

引力子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，该生物所处空间以及所有与它相邻的方格，对该生物变为困难地形，直至其下个回合结束。

光量子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，你额外造成等同于你等级一半的火焰伤害（向上取整）。你的恒星武器在5尺半径内散发出明亮光照（在此后5尺内散发昏暗光照）。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]

items.name: 星辰调谐
items.expectedDescription:
As a solarian, your existence cycles between the aspects of stars. You begin with two aspects: photon (the power of stars to emit heat, light, and plasma) and graviton (the power of stars to attract and imprison objects through gravity). At any time, you're considered graviton-attuned, photon-attuned, or unattuned. Many of your abilities have additional effects based on your current attunement, and some abilities swap your current state of attunement to another state.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] action.
items.description:
作为一名恒星武士，星辰面相间的循环决定了你的存在。你初始拥有两种面相：光量子（photon，星辰散发出热量、光以及等离子体的力量）或引力子（graviton，星辰通过引力吸引和束缚物体的力量）。在任何情况下，你都处在引力子调谐、光量子调谐、或未调谐三种情况之一。你的许多能力都会根据你的当前调谐产生额外的效果，而有些能力则会将你的当前调谐转变成另一种情况。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]动作。

items.name: 光晕涌动
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your nimbus surges with energy, forcing an opening in your foe's defenses. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Graviton-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its turn.

Photon-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its turn.
items.description:
触发 你触及范围内的一个生物使用操作或移动动作，进行远程攻击，或者使用移动动作时离开一个方格。

你的光晕迸发能量，强行撕开敌人的防御。对触发生物进行一次近战打击。这次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值，你的多重攻击减值也不应用于此次打击。

引力子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到其回合结束。

光量子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，直到其回合开始。

items.name: 重铸恒星武器
items.expectedDescription:
You spend 10 minutes focusing on the composition of your solar weapon. You can change your solar weapon's damage type (typically choosing between bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing), selected traits, and weapon group. Your weapon maintains your selections until the next time you Re-Forge Solar Weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]
items.description:
你花费10分钟的时间专注于调整你恒星武器的构造。你可以更改武器的伤害类型（通常情况下在钝击、穿刺或挥砍之中选择），所选的武器特征，以及所属的武器组。恒星武器会始终保留你的选择，直至你下一次重铸恒星武器。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

items.name: 调和
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

You steady your body and mind and attune yourself to the stellar aspect of your choice. You become attuned to photon or graviton. You can also manifest any of your solar manifestations if they're currently dormant and if you have the free hands to use them.

Special In addition to the above usage, you can also Attune as a free action when you roll initiative.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]
items.description:
频率 每轮一次

稳定身心，与所选的星辰面相调谐一致。你变得与光量子或引力子调谐。你可以也选择显现你的恒星显象，只要它们当前处于休眠状态，且你有一只空手来使用它们。

特殊 除了上述用法外，你可以在掷骰先攻时，以自由动作使用调和。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

items.name: 星辰韧性
items.expectedDescription: Stellar energy flows throughout your entire being like an unstoppable tidal wave, strengthening both body and mind. Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to expert. When you roll a success on a Fortitude or Will save against a mental or incapacitation effect, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] as a free action.
items.description: 星辰能量如汹涌海潮般贯穿你的整个躯体，强化身心。你在强韧豁免上的熟练度提升至专家。当你在对抗心灵或失能效果的强韧或意志豁免上骰出成功结果时，你可以用自由动作进行@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]。

items.name: 战斗丝带
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This sheer nanocarbon ribbon is sharp enough to cut through flesh without interrupting the traditional battle dances that make the weapon famous.
items.description:
强化： 1

这条轻薄的纳米碳丝带锋利到足以切开血肉，又不会打断让这种武器闻名的传统战舞。

items.name: 突击队血清
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This tangy crimson elixir grants you 1d10+5 temporary Hit Points, as well as a +5-foot item bonus to any Speed you have for 1 minute. When you drink this serum, your veins protrude, and your eyes take on a reddish tinge.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.uf3Fb7Fm7dSzc7Os]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

这种味道浓烈的深红色灵药给予你持续1分钟的1d10+5点临时生命值，以及你所拥有的任何速度上的+5尺物品加值。当你饮用这个血清时，你的静脉会外凸，而你的眼睛会呈现微红色调。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.uf3Fb7Fm7dSzc7Os]

items.name: 双核增强器
items.expectedDescription:
This magitech interface is a sophisticated pair of linked bracers, wristbands, gloves, or other garments suitable to the part of a creature's anatomy it uses to wield weapons. One of the paired enhancers includes a screen that displays data about the weapons the wearer is wielding, and the other enhancer contains magical crystals. When you wield a weapon in the hand wearing the display, the weapon's grade (such as tactical) is replicated onto the weapon you're wielding in the hand with the crystal enhancer, but only for purposes of determining the weapon's extra damage dice and tracking trait (which adds an item bonus to attack rolls). Any other properties of the weapon, such as its damage type, ammo, or upgrades, aren't replicated.

The replication functions only if you wear both enhancers, and it ends as soon as you cease wielding a weapon in one of your hands. Consequently, the benefit doesn't apply to thrown attacks or if you're holding a weapon but not wielding it (such as holding in one hand a weapon that requires two hands to wield, or holding a weapon in non-active hands).
items.description:
这种魔法科技界面是一对相互连接的精密护腕、腕带、手套或其他穿戴物，适配生物用于持用武器的身体部位。成对强化器中的一个配有屏幕，显示穿戴者持用武器的数据，另一个则装有魔法水晶。当你用戴着显示器的手持用武器时，该武器的品质（例如战术型）会复制到你用戴着水晶强化器的手持用的武器上，但仅用于确定武器的额外伤害骰和追踪特征（该特征提供攻击掷骰的物品加值）。武器的其他属性，例如伤害类型、弹药或强化模块，都不会被复制。

复制效果只有在你同时穿戴两个强化器时才会生效，且只要有一只手不再持用武器，效果就立即结束。因此，此增益不适用于投掷攻击，也不适用于你持握武器但未持用它的情况（例如以单手持握需要双手持用的武器，或用非当前使用的手持握武器）。

items.name: 掠夺者护甲
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Freebooter armor is named for the pirates and outlaws who often wear these outfits. Freebooter armor typically consists of a breastplate worn under a jacket or flight suit, heavy boots and gloves, a helmet, and hidden straps and holsters for concealing weapons.
items.description:
强化： 1

掠夺者护甲因常穿戴它的海盗和亡命徒而得名。掠夺者护甲通常包括穿在夹克或飞行服里面的胸甲、厚重的靴子与手套、头盔，以及用于藏匿武器的隐蔽绑带和枪套。

extraFields.expected:

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 龙之武器熟练
items.expectedDescription:
You wield weapons favored by the Skyfire Legion. You are trained with the skyfire sword, flamethrower, and machine gun. In addition, you gain access to all uncommon weapons with the dragonkin trait. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.
items.description:
你使用天火军团青睐的武器。你在天火剑、喷火器和机枪上受训。此外，你还可以使用所有具有龙人特征的罕见武器。在计算熟练度时，你将任何军用武器视为简易武器，将任何进阶武器视为军用武器。

在5级时，每当你使用这些武器造成重击时，你将获得其重击专精效果。

items.name: 恒星护盾
items.expectedDescription:
You've developed a new solar manifestation—a small shield of stellar energy that orbits you. This energy shield has the attuned and solarian traits and doesn't require a hand to use. You can Raise a Shield, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. You gain the Shield Block general feat.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.q5W7fV1wXvqBFxt8]

While the shield is raised, you can use the Shield Block reaction with your shield. The shield has Hit Points equal to 5 plus twice your level and Hardness equal to half your level, rounded up. Your shield can't be broken, but if it's destroyed, you can't manifest a new shield for 10 minutes. If your shield vanishes due to you losing attunement, when you Attune to reform it, the shield returns with however many Hit Points it previously had. The shield regains all its lost Hit Points during your daily preparations and whenever you rest for at least 10 minutes, even if it's been destroyed.

Graviton-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a shock wave. Adjacent enemies must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure).

Photon-Attuned If your shield is destroyed, it releases a flash of light. Adjacent enemies must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical failure).
items.description:
你开发出一种新的恒星显象——一个环绕你旋转的星辰能量小护盾。该能量护盾具有调谐和恒星武士特征，不需要手来使用。你可以举起盾牌，在AC上获得+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始。你获得盾牌格挡通用专长。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.q5W7fV1wXvqBFxt8]

当盾牌被举起时，你可以使用你的护盾来进行盾牌格挡反应动作。护盾具有5加上两倍你等级的生命值，以及等同于你等级一半的硬度，向上取整。你的护盾不会破损，如果它被摧毁，你在10分钟内无法再次显现一面新护盾。如果你的护盾因为你失去调谐而消失，那么当你使用调和重塑它时，护盾会以之前拥有的生命值回归。在每日准备期间或你休息至少10分钟时，护盾会恢复所有已损失生命值，即便其已被摧毁。

引力子调谐如果你的盾牌被摧毁，它会释放一道冲击波。相邻敌人必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]1轮（大失败则为2轮）。

光量子调谐如果你的盾牌被摧毁，它会释放一道闪光。相邻敌人必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}1轮（大失败则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}1轮）。

items.name: 盾牌格挡
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger While you have your shield raised, you would take physical damage (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) from an attack.

You snap your shield in place to ward off a blow. Your shield prevents you from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. You and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.
items.description:
触发 你已举起盾牌，并将要受到攻击造成的物理伤害（钝击、穿刺或挥砍）。

你眼疾手快地调整盾牌位置，接下一次猛击。你的盾牌为你减免至多等于盾牌硬度的伤害值。你和盾牌均会受到其余的伤害，这可能导致盾牌破损或被摧毁。

items.name: 健壮
items.expectedDescription: Your body can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1.
items.description: 在支撑到极限前，你的身体可以经受比大多数人更沉重的损伤。你的最大生命值提高等于你的等级的数值。你的恢复检定DC降低1点。

items.name: 动人表演
items.expectedDescription: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]] using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.
items.description: 你的表演广受追捧，为你赢得拥趸。你可以用表演技能替代交涉技能[[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]{改善印象}。若你在观众面前表演至少10分钟，就能够以至多10个观看了整段表演的观众为改善印象的目标，无需承受通常情况的减值。若表演1小时，目标数量提高到20个；若表演2小时，提高到50个。

items.name: 星辰冲刺
items.expectedDescription:
You rush forward with a blast of stellar energy, getting into the thick of combat with ease. Stride twice. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed during these moves.

Graviton-Attuned When you finish your Strides, enemies within 15 feet of you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement] save against your class DC. On a failure, they're pulled directly toward you, ending in an adjacent square if possible. You select the order these enemies are moved.

Photon-Attuned When you finish your Strides, you create a photon field in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] centered on you. Until the start of your next turn, creatures outside the photon field are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to creatures inside the field.
items.description:
你在星辰能量的加持下冲刺向前，轻而易举地深入战场的中心。行走两次。在此次移动期间，你的速度获得+10尺环境加值。

引力子调谐当你完成行走时，你15尺内的敌人必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement]以对抗你的职业DC。失败时，敌人会被直线拉向你，直至其到达与你相邻范围内的一个方格（如果可能的话）。你可以选择敌人被拉向你的先后顺序。

光量子调谐当你完成行走时，你在以自身为中心的@Template[type:burst|distance:15]创造一个光量子场。直至你的下个回合开始，光量子场外部的生物对光量子场内的生物视作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

items.name: 阿卡西下载
items.expectedDescription:
You execute a psychic search of the Akashic Record for information about a specific topic and magically transfer this data to your comm unit or computer. When you Cast this Spell, choose any skill in which you're trained that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action.

Any time during the duration, you can consult your comm unit while attempting a Recall Knowledge check using your chosen skill. This check gains a +1 status bonus. Checking your comm unit is part of the action to Recall Knowledge. You must be holding the comm unit to do so. The comm unit instantly compiles and displays snippets and selections from various media relevant to the topic, which grants you the bonus. If you roll a critical failure on this check, you get a failure instead. If the check is successful and the subject is a creature, you gain additional information or context about the creature. Once you reference the comm unit, the spell ends. When the spell ends, your access to the Akashic Record ends, and all the information you downloaded returns to the Akashic Record.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

Heightened (3rd) You can reference your comm unit three times before the spell ends.
items.description:
你通过灵能搜索阿卡西记录，获取特定主题的信息，并将数据魔法传输至通讯单元或计算机。施放此法术时，选择任何你至少为受训熟练度且能进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]动作的技能。

在持续时间内的任何时候，你都可以在使用所选技能进行回忆知识检定时查询通讯单元。该检定会获得+1状态加值。检查通讯单元是回忆知识动作的一部分。你必须手持通讯单元才能这样做。通讯单元会立即编译并显示与主题相关的各种媒体片段和精选内容，从而为你带来加值。如果你在检定中掷出大失败，改为失败。如果检定成功，且对象是生物，你将获得有关该生物的额外信息或内容。一旦你查询了通讯单元的信息，法术就会结束。当法术结束时，你对阿卡西记录的访问也会结束，你下载的所有信息都会返回阿卡西记录。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.h1i8c47U0IOrMrHJ]

升阶（3环）法术结束前可以用通讯单元查询信息3次。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 讯息传递
items.expectedDescription: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.
items.description: 你将你和目标的精神链接在一起，并且将通常需要10分钟来交流的信息在一瞬间通过精神传递给对方。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.
items.description:
你重新编程一台计算机或设备，使其在被访问时显示一条选定的数据。你每个法术环级至多可以植入一条数据。一条数据可以是一项简单事实，例如某个生物或物体的位置或外貌描述；一幅生物或物体的图像；或一句不超过300个字符的简单陈述。目标计算机或设备被访问时，访问者首先获得的总是这条植入数据，无论该生物在寻找什么数据。植入数据不会阻止生物访问设备储存的其他信息，不会改变设备的运作方式，也不会以其他方式妨碍其运作。如果法术持续时间在生物访问植入数据前结束，这些信息便消失。

升阶（3环）持续时间为一年。

升阶（6环）持续时间为无限。

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 零度短刃
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Unfolding like a switchblade, a supercooled chamber within this weapon instantly forms a blade of ice.
items.description:
强化： 1

此武器如弹簧折刀般展开，内部过冷腔室瞬间形成一片冰刃。

items.name: 电弧手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把笨重的手枪不使用传统弹药，而是内置一个能够产生电弧的电容器。枪托由聚碳材料或其他合成绝缘材料制成，通常染成亮黄色，并刻有表示高压电的通用闪电符号。

items.name: 半自动手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。

items.name: 阿卡西源泉
items.expectedDescription: You open the target's mind to the Akashic Record to draw in feelings, memories, and knowledge contained within that astral repository. Choose one Lore skill. The target temporarily gains the same proficiency rank in that skill as your proficiency rank in Occultism.
items.description: 你开启目标的心灵，进入阿卡西记录，从中汲取情感、记忆和知识。选择一个学识技能。目标在该技能的熟练等级上暂时获得你在神秘技能上的熟练等级。

items.name: 商用型爆燃手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 1d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:5]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击击退5尺

这类手雷点燃化学物质，引发炽热的爆炸，造成1d8点火焰伤害，并进行 @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] 豁免（@Template[burst|distance:5]）。如果你可以使用手雷的重击专精效果，对抗燃烧手雷的豁免检定大失败的生物会被推离手雷。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 第二皮肤
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
items.description:
强化： 0

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 仿生人
items.expectedDescription: Androids first emerged as synthetic beings crafted by many technologically advanced civilizations throughout the galaxy. The first androids were created by humanoid peoples in their own images, but after the technology that animated the living constructs spread, androids began displaying a fantastic diversity of forms. Androids in the Pact Worlds were originally designed as servants, but today androids and other robotic beings stand as equals to organic ancestries under the Pact. Some androids have formed their own independent communities, while most integrate seamlessly into Pact Worlds societies. Unlike many other technological constructs, androids are more than intricate synthetic organs and complex programming, and each possesses their own soul.
items.description: 仿生人最初是星系中许多科技发达的文明制造的合成生命。最早的仿生人是类人生物按照自身形象创造的，但随着赋予这些活体构装体生命的技术传播开来，仿生人也开始呈现出千姿百态的形貌。协约世界的仿生人最初被设计为仆役，但如今，根据协约，仿生人与其他机器人生命已与有机族裔享有平等地位。一些仿生人建立了独立的社群，大多数则顺利融入协约世界的社会。与许多其他科技构装体不同，仿生人并不只是精密的合成器官与复杂的程序；每个仿生人都拥有自己的灵魂。

items.name: 构装体
items.expectedDescription: Your synthetic body resists ailments better than those of purely biological organisms. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation.
items.description: 你的人造身体比单纯的生物机体更能抵抗疾患。你对疾病、毒素和辐射的豁免检定获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 联网仿生人
items.expectedDescription: Your body was modified to network seamlessly with other tech creatures. You gain shortwave, allowing you to communicate wirelessly with any creatures within 30 feet, as long as they have shortwave or are a construct with the tech trait. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts or programming and communicates no more information than normal speech would. You can attempt Computers checks to Hack systems, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4], create a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} without a hacker's toolkit or free hand at a range of 30 feet.
items.description: 你的身体经过改造，可以与其他科技生物无缝联网。你获得短波（shortwave），让你可以与30尺内任意生物进行无线交流，只要他们拥有短波，或则是具有科技特征的构装体。这不会给予任何对他们思维或程序的特殊访问方式，且交流中不带有比任何正常说话更多信息。你无需黑客工具包或空手便可以对30尺范围内的科技设备尝试计算机检定来骇入系统（Hack System），@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]（Combat Hack），进行@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]（Digital Diversion），@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]。

items.name: 侦探
items.expectedDescription:
You solved crimes as a police inspector or took clandestine jobs for various clients as a private investigator. You might have become an adventurer as part of your next big mystery, but it's equally likely it was due to the consequences or aftermath of a prior case.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill, and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} Streetwise skill feat.
items.description:
你曾以警方探员的身份侦破犯罪，或作为私家侦探，为各类客户承接秘密委托。你可能为了追查下一个重大谜团而成为冒险者，也同样可能是因为此前某个案件的后果或余波而踏上冒险。

选择两项属性提升。其中一项必须用于智力或感知，另一项为自由属性提升。

你的社群技能和黑社会学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{人情练达}技能专长。

items.name: 人情练达
items.expectedDescription: You know about life on the streets and feel the pulse of your local settlement. You can use your Society modifier instead of your Diplomacy modifier to [[/act gather-information skill=society]]{Gather Information}. In any settlement you frequent regularly, you can use the Recall Knowledge action with Society to know the same sorts of information that you could discover with Diplomacy to Gather Information. The DC is usually significantly higher, but you know the information without spending time gathering it. If you fail to recall the information, you can still subsequently attempt to Gather Information normally.
items.description: 你熟悉街头生活，掌握当地聚居地的脉动。你可以使用社群调整值代替交涉调整值来[[/act gather-information skill=society]]{搜集信息}。在经常造访的聚居地，你可以用社群进行回忆知识，获知通常能够通过交涉收集信息得到的同类情报。DC通常高得多，但你不需要花费收集信息的时间，就能知道这些情报。如果未能回忆起信息，你之后仍可正常尝试收集信息。

items.name: 秘术师
items.expectedDescription: You're a conduit, channeling the fundamental forces that connect and bind everything in the cosmos. You can draw upon this supernatural wellspring to form deep spiritual bonds with your allies, empower them in combat, and restore their health should they become injured. Your powers take unique shape based on the connection you choose, granting new and more powerful spells as you explore your connection on a deeper level.
items.description: 你是传导者，引导着连接并维系宇宙万物的基本力量。你可以汲取这股超自然源泉，与盟友建立深厚的灵性纽带，在战斗中强化他们，并在他们受伤时恢复其健康。你的力量因所选联结而呈现独特形态；随着你对联结的探索不断深入，你将获得新的、更强大的法术。

items.name: 命能网络
items.expectedDescription:
Your soul supports a network of energy that connects and heals those in your bond. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to 6 + 4 Hit Points per level. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG] action that you can use to take Hit Points out of your network and into yourself or your allies as healing.

Life-and-death situations help strengthen your bonds with your allies. At the start of each turn in combat, when you regain actions, your vitality network regains 4 Hit Points; if you're master in spell DC, it regains 6 Hit Points instead; if you're legendary, it regains 8 Hit Points. When you Refocus, your vitality network regains all its Hit Points.
items.description:
你的灵魂支持着一个连结并治愈你纽带中生物的能量网络。你的命能网络具有等同于6+每等级4点生命值的最大容量。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]动作，可以用来从你的网络中提取生命值并将其转移到自己或盟友身上进行治疗。

生死攸关的情况有助于加固你与盟友的纽带。在战斗中每回合开始，当你重新获得动作时，你的命能网络会恢复4点生命值；如果你的法术DC为大师熟练度，它改为恢复6点生命值；如果你达到传奇熟练度，它会恢复8点生命值。当你再聚能时，你的命能网络会恢复全部生命值。

items.name: 联结
items.expectedDescription:
All mystics have a supernatural connection with a cosmic force that grants magical powers. The exact nature of your connection can vary widely—you might worship a god or pantheon, embody a metaphysical concept, become a conduit for nature's wrath, or something else. Even mystics who share the same connection might interpret the source of their powers differently. At 1st level, choose your connection. Your chosen connection determines the type of spells you cast and the spell tradition you choose spells from, your additional trained skill, the epiphanies you learn, and a harmony that usually grants creatures a special benefit when you heal them with your vitality network.

items.description:
所有秘术师都与赋予魔法力量的宇宙伟力有着超自然的联结。你联结的具体性质可以有很大的不同——你可能崇拜一位神或万神殿，具现为一种形而上的概念，成为自然之怒的传导者，或是其他形态。即使是拥有相同联结的秘术师也可能对力量来源作出不同解读。1级时，选择你的联结。你所选的联结决定了你施放的法术类型和法术根源，你的额外受训技能，你掌握的顿悟，以及一种协调，一种在你用命能网络治愈生物时通常会赋予它们的特殊增益。

items.name: 转移命能
items.expectedDescription: You can transfer up to 10 Hit Points (minimum 1) from your vitality network into yourself or a bonded creature you can sense within 60 feet. This works on creatures with void healing as though this action had the void trait. The amount you can transfer increases by 10 at 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th level.
items.description: 你能从你的命能网络中转移至多10点生命值（最小1点）到你自身或60尺内一名你能感知到纽带中的生物身上。这能对具有虚能治疗的生物生效，如同此动作具有虚能特征。你能转移的数值分别在5级，10级，15级和20级时增加10点。

items.name: 阿卡西
items.expectedDescription:
You maintain a permanent psychic link to the Akashic Record, the supernatural repository of all knowledge in the multiverse. This connection allows you to access knowledge that otherwise would remain beyond the grasp of regular mortal minds.

Tradition occult

Connection Skill Occultism

Connection Spells cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.nf8q0zvJDnnkzANe]; 1st: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.VynaowCerc7B4yvI]; 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.mnoTqz0gjRmuc4oR]; 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition}; 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.kTzbLqmqPcZwOa5F]; 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}; 7th: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.zdzeVZlKHkMAt2Rf]; 8th: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.f98vwzcdxafum8ln]; 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qsNeG9KZpODSACMq]{Foresight}

Harmony When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG], the target receives a psychic download from the Akashic Record and can immediately attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} as a reaction. 你与阿卡西记录保持着永恒的心灵链接，这个超自然的知识库包含了多元宇宙中的所有知识。这个联结使你能够接触到以普通凡人的心智无法触及的知识。

根源异能

联结技能神秘
