items.name: 初等顿悟
items.expectedDescription:
You discover the basic truth of your connection. You learn your chosen connection's initial epiphany spell. Epiphany spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to spend time with your bonded allies or otherwise ponder the nature of your connection.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.
items.description:
你发现了你联结中最基本的真理。你获得了所选联结的初始顿悟法术。顿悟法术是一种聚能法术。施放聚能法术需要消耗1点聚能点，并且你在开始时拥有一个1点聚能点的聚能池。你在每日准备时重新填满你的聚能池，你可以通过花费10分钟使用再聚能行动来恢复1点聚能点，这包括与纽带中的盟友共度时光，或思考你联结的本质。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你等级的一半，向上取整，和戏法类似。聚能法术无需法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。获取专长能够赋予你聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，不过你的聚能池不能容纳超过3点聚能点。

items.name: 秘术师施法
items.expectedDescription:
You are a spellcaster and can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a mystic, when you cast spells, you might intone a prayer or hum a song inspired by your epiphanies, you might gesture or dance in patterns that follow the flow of your connection's network, and you might accompany your spellcasting with wisps of energy flowing between you and your bonded allies.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a mystic, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast, as shown on the Mystic Spells per Day table.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Wisdom, your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks. The signature spells class feature lets you heighten certain spells freely.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of mystic spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level mystic, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level mystic, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.
items.description:
你是一名施法者，并且可以使用施法行动进行施放法术。作为一名秘术师，当你施放法术时，你可能会吟唱祷词或哼唱受顿悟启发的歌谣，你可能会用手势或舞蹈来追随你联结网络的流变，又或许会在施法时让能量丝缕在你与纽带中的盟友间流淌。

每天，你可以施放至多三个1环法术。你必须知晓法术才能施放它们，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习它们。你每天可以施放的法术数量称作你的法术位。

随着你秘术师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如秘术师每日法术表所示。

一些法术需要你尝试法术攻击来判断他们多有效，或让你的敌人掷骰对抗你的法术DC（通常是尝试豁免骰）。因为你的关键属性是感知，你的法术攻击调整和法术DC都使用你的感知调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。标志性法术职业能力可以让你自由升阶特定的法术。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整——这通常等于你拥有的秘术师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级秘术师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级秘术师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

items.name: 秘术纽带
items.expectedDescription:
You form a bond between yourself and others, most typically your closest companions. Forming bonds is different for every mystic but always involves using a 10-minute activity related to the mystic's connection that requires you to be adjacent to the creature with whom you wish to bond. You can maintain a bond with up to 10 other willing creatures, and the bond lasts until you or the bonded creature are no longer willing to be part of the bond. You are always considered part of your own bond and don't count toward the 10-creature limit.

You always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, their Hit Point totals, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. This ability doesn't work across planes (including when in transit in the Drift), and some special magical or technological effects might interfere with your ability to detect your allies.
items.description:
你在自己和他人之间建立纽带，通常是与你最亲密的伙伴。秘术师们建立纽带的具体方式各不相同，但都需要花费一个和秘术师的联结相关的10分钟行动。你可以与至多10个其他自愿的生物建立纽带，并且纽带一直持续到你或某个被建立纽带的生物不再自愿成为纽带的一部分。你自己总是被认为是你纽带中的一部分，并且不计入10个生物的上限。

你总是知道其他联结生物的大致距离和方向，他们的生命值总数，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。这种能力在跨位面（包括漂流域中的通行）时不起作用，一些特殊的魔法或科技效果可能会干扰你侦测盟友的能力。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.
items.description:
秘术师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及来自你联结的额外法术和戏法。你从你联结对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术，或者从你获得许可的其他源自你魔法根源的法术中进行选择。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。当你获得新的法术环位时，你的第一个新法术总是对应环级的来自你联结的授予法术，然后你可以选择其他你获取的法术。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，可能会想替换之前学过的部分法术。每次你升级并学习新法术时，可以将一个旧法术替换为另一个同环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但你不能替换顿悟法术或联结法术。你也可以通过休整期重训替换法术。

织维巫师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及悖论赋予你的额外法术和戏法。你从你悖论对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，你可能会想要替换之前学习的一些法术。每次你获得新的等级学习新的法术时，你可以将一个旧法术置换为一个同一环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但是你不能替换悖论的授予法术。你也可以通过休整期重训来替换法术。

items.name: 迅捷处理器
items.expectedDescription: You can quickly identify your surroundings, and you can use that information to your advantage while in the midst of danger or while in the process of piloting vehicles in hazardous situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls and a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks for initiative rolls.
items.description: 你可以快速识别周围的环境，你可以使用该信息来在危险中或在危险情况驾驶车辆时获得优势。你在用于掷骰先攻的察觉检定上获得+1环境加值，在用于掷骰先攻的驾驶（Piloting）检定上获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 精灵
items.expectedDescription:
For millennia, elves have dwelled among the stars and charted courses across the galaxy. A wide diaspora of elves have lived across a hundred worlds for many thousands of years, connected to each other by a shared history of skycraft, magic, and cosmic wonder.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.YL5t9HQfv8YAsyw4]{Elf}
items.description:
数千年来，精灵居于群星之间，在星系中绘制航线。散居各地的精灵在百个世界生活了数千年，以航天、魔法和宇宙奇观的共同历史彼此相连。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.YL5t9HQfv8YAsyw4]{精灵}

items.name: 伊薇兰精灵
items.expectedDescription:
Before the advent of Drift travel or shadow drives, elves toured the galaxy on century-long voyages in great starship caravans. You're one of the ivairan, descended from these ancient elven travelers. Your family still upholds the traditions of your ancestors by exploring the galaxy, learning about the civilizations they meet in their travels, and charting new and unknown courses through the wilds of the Vast.

During your daily preparations, you can reflect on what you've heard from fellow travelers and on your experiences visiting a city, space station, or planet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for a Lore subcategory about a specific place (such as Absalom Station Lore or Akiton Lore) until you make your preparations again. Since this feat is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for any character option.
items.description:
在漂流域航行或阴影引擎问世之前，精灵便乘坐庞大的星舰商队，以长达百年的旅程游历星系。你是伊薇兰精灵，是这些古代精灵旅行者的后裔。你的家族仍恪守祖先的传统，探索星系、了解旅途中相遇的文明，并在浩界荒野中开辟未知的新航线。

每日准备时，你可以回想从旅伴处听来的见闻，以及自己造访城市、空间站或行星的经历。你获得用于某个具体地点相关学识子类别的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{额外学识}专长，例如艾巴萨罗姆空间站学识或阿基顿学识，直到你再次进行每日准备。由于此专长是临时获得的，你不能将其作为任何角色选项的先决条件。

items.name: 外交官
items.expectedDescription:
You've dedicated your career to facilitating peaceful alliances between different factions and peoples. You might work at an intergalactic embassy or travel aboard a starship on a mission to remote space. First contact situations are your specialty.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Diplomacy skill and one Lore skill for a planet of your choosing. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat.
items.description:
你将自己的职业生涯奉献给促进不同派别和民族之间的合作与和平联盟。你可能在一个星际大使馆工作，或者乘坐星际飞船前往偏远的太空执行任务。你最擅长初次接触。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是智力或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的交涉技能和由你选择的某个星球的学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]（Group Impression）技能专长。

items.name: 集体印象
items.expectedDescription: When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, you can compare your Diplomacy check result to the Will DCs of up to 10 targets you conversed with, with no penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 if you're an expert, 50 if you're a master, and 100 if you're legendary.
items.description: 在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}时，你可以将交涉检定结果与跟你交流的至多10个目标的意志DC相比较，且无需承受减值。若你在交涉技能上的熟练度达到专家，目标数量提高到20个；若达到大师，提高到50个；若达到传奇，提高到100个。

items.name: 使节
items.expectedDescription:
You're a master influencer. You make your way in the universe with a charming smile, quick wit, and keen sense of self-preservation. You're a leader who motivates your teammates, pushes them past their limits, and helps them through tough spots. You excel at getting others to do what you want, but you're always ready to face trouble head-on when things take a turn for the worse. You might be a con artist, diplomat, performer, or military officer—or you might take on whatever role the situation demands.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.r2bLZofQDDBIk6Ir]{Envoy}
items.description:
你是影响他人的大师。你凭借迷人的微笑、敏捷的才思和敏锐的自保意识闯荡宇宙。你是激励队友、推动他们突破极限并助其渡过难关的领袖。你擅长让他人依照你的意愿行事，但在局势恶化时，也总准备好直面麻烦。你可能是骗子、外交官、表演者或军官，也可能根据局势的需要扮演任何角色。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.r2bLZofQDDBIk6Ir]{使节}

items.name: 使节指令
items.expectedDescription:
Envoys encourage their allies with directives. A directive is an order that benefits allies who follow it. Envoy directives include a way for the envoy to lead by example by spending more actions for increased effects. Directives have the auditory or visual trait depending on how you inspire your allies.

You begin with one envoy directive. You can learn more directives through the envoy class, envoy class feats, and your leadership style. You can issue one directive a round. Unless otherwise stated, an envoy's directive and the benefits it grants last until the beginning of your next turn.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy] envoy directive.
items.description:
使节通过指令来鼓励盟友。指令是对遵守指令的盟友有利的命令。使节指令包括让使节以身作则的方式，花费更多动作来获得更多效果。指令具有听觉或视觉特征，取决于你激励盟友的方式。

你初始有一个使节指令。你可以通过使节职业，使节职业专长，和你的领导风格学到更多指令。你每轮可以下达一个指令。除非另有说明，使节的指令及其赋予的增益会持续到你的下回合开始。

你获得“@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]”使节指令。

items.name: 领导风格
items.expectedDescription:
Whether it comes naturally, or you trained for it, you've developed a personal style of leading others. At 1st level, select a leadership style. You become trained in the indicated leadership skill, you gain the indicated leadership perk, and know the associated leadership directive.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.u2dy5FMDv30UH8HC]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.KEoTccJlfKzMk19l]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.jaGIV3t7G07F0qda]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.6cFaxZ4aAhuUbnwi]
items.description:
无论是你是处于自然而然，还是经受训练，你都已经形成了领导他人的个人风格。在1级时，选择一种领导风格。你在所示领导技能上受训，并获得所示领导奖励，并掌握相关领导指令。

items.name: 干掉他！
items.expectedDescription:
You single out an enemy for you and your allies to focus your attacks on. Select an enemy within 60 feet that you can see. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attacks against that target until the beginning of your next turn.

Lead by Example If you used two actions, Strike the target. You gain a status bonus to the damage roll equal to your Charisma modifier. Regardless of whether the Strike hits, you and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to damage on subsequent Strikes made against the enemy until the start of your next turn. Increase the damage by 1 at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.ey2zSEnprAGgvrij]
items.description:
你选定一名敌人，让自己和盟友集中攻击它。选择60尺内你能看见的一个敌人。你和盟友对该目标的攻击获得+1状态加值，直到你的下个回合开始。

以身作则 若你使用了两个动作，打击该目标。你在伤害掷骰中获得等同于自身魅力调整值的状态加值。无论该次打击是否命中，你和盟友随后对该敌人进行打击时，伤害均获得+1状态加值，直到你的下个回合开始。此伤害在以下每个等级增加1：5、10、15与20级。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.ey2zSEnprAGgvrij]

items.name: 人群焦点
items.expectedDescription:
Whether through conversation, clever lies, dazzling performances, or threats, you rely on charm and cunning to influence others. You crave being in the spotlight.

Leadership Skill Performance

Leadership Perk You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} as a bonus feat.

Leadership Directive @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.rlhZC1VPq3XixagS]
items.description:
无论是通过交谈，巧妙的谎言，令人眼花缭乱的表演，还是威胁，你都依赖于魅力和狡猾来影响他人。你渴望成为聚光灯下的焦点。

领导技能表演

领导奖励你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]作为奖励专长。

领导指令 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.rlhZC1VPq3XixagS]

items.name: 来吧舞伴！
items.expectedDescription:
Every good performer needs an accompanying act. Nominate yourself and an ally within 10 feet. Stride or Step, then your ally can Stride or Step as a reaction as long as they end the same distance or closer to you than they started.

Lead by Example If you used two actions, enemies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your Strikes if within reach of your selected ally, and vice-versa, until the start of your next turn. Your ally becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against ranged Strikes made by creatures within 10 feet until the start of your next turn or the ally moves, whichever comes first.
items.description:
每位优秀的表演者都需要一名舞伴。指名你自己和10尺内一名盟友。你行走或快步，然后你的盟友可以使用一个反应动作行走或快步，只要他在结束移动时与你保持相同距离或更近。

以身作则如果你使用两个动作，敌人如果处于你所选盟友触及内，对你的打击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]，反之亦然，直到你的下个回合开始。你的盟友对由10尺内生物进行的远程打击视作具有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]，直到你的下个回合开始或该盟友移动，以先满足者为准。

items.name: 动人表演
items.expectedDescription: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can [[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]] using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.
items.description: 你的表演广受追捧，为你赢得拥趸。你可以用表演技能替代交涉技能[[/act make-an-impression skill=performance]]{改善印象}。若你在观众面前表演至少10分钟，就能够以至多10个观看了整段表演的观众为改善印象的目标，无需承受通常情况的减值。若表演1小时，目标数量提高到20个；若表演2小时，提高到50个。

items.name: 适应天赋
items.expectedDescription:
You're quick thinking and adaptable, capable of picking up new skills and talents with little practice or training. During your daily preparations, select one skill feat that you meet the prerequisites for. You gain this skill feat until you prepare again. Since you have this feat temporarily, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option. You can use this for effects that temporarily give you access to other abilities, such as taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} to temporarily learn a new language.

As your envoy level increases, so does your ability to adapt to new situations. At 9th level and 15th level, increase the number of skill feats you gain this way by 1. You can use feats that you temporarily gain through adaptive talent as a prerequisite for other feats that you temporarily gain through adaptive talent, but you still can't use them as prerequisites for permanent character options.
items.description:
你思维敏捷，适应力强，不需要太多训练或培训就能掌握新的技能和能力。在每日准备中，选择一项你满足先决条件的技能专长。你获得该技能专长直到你再次每日准备。由于你是临时拥有此专长，你无法将其用作永久角色选项的先决条件。你可以将此技能专长用作临时给予你其他能力的效果，例如获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]来临时学习一门新语言。

随着使节等级提高，你适应新状况的能力也会提升。在9级和15级，分别增加1个你以此方式获得的技能专长数量。你可以使用通过适应天赋临时获得的专长来作为你通过适应天赋临时获得的其他专长的先决条件，但你仍然不能将它们用作永久角色选项的先决条件。

items.name: 看破局面
items.expectedDescription: Using your words to influence others is what you do, and you easily recognize when others attempt to use the same tactics against you. You gain a +1 status bonus to your Perception DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} to you and attempts to divert your attention with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion}, and a +1 status bonus to your Will DC against emotion effects.
items.description: 用言语影响他人是你的第二天性，而且你可以轻易辨认出其他人尝试对你使用的相同手段。你在对抗尝试对你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]时，以及尝试用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]转移你注意力时，察觉DC获得+1状态加值，并且在对抗情绪效果时你的意志DC获得+1状态加值。

items.name: 族裔技能
items.expectedDescription:
You have a keen interest in the origins of your people. You become trained in the skills listed in your ancestry's skills entry. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for the Lore skill associated with your ancestry (for example, androids have Android Lore and ysoki have Ysoki Lore).
items.description:
你对你民族的起源有着浓厚的兴趣。你在族裔技能条目所列技能上成为受训。如果你将要在这些技能之一中自动成为受训（例如来自你的背景或职业），你改为任选一项技能成为受训。

你还会获得与你族裔相关的学识技能的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]通用专长（例如，仿生人拥有仿生人学识而鼠人拥有鼠人学识）。

items.name: 额外学识
items.expectedDescription:
Your knowledge has expanded to encompass a new field. Choose a Lore skill subcategory. You become trained in it. At 3rd, 7th, and 15th levels, you gain an additional skill increase you can apply only to the chosen Lore subcategory.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you must select a new subcategory of Lore and you gain the additional skill increases to that subcategory for the listed levels.
items.description:
你的知识扩展到了新的领域。选择一个学识技能的子类别，你对其受训。在3级、7级、15级时，你获得额外的技能提升，仅能用于提升所选的学识。

特殊 你可以多次选取本专长。每次都必须选择不同的学识子类别，在列出的等级，你同样会获得针对该学识的额外技能提升。

items.name: 评估
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

You spend 1 minute observing a specific individual, 10 minutes researching a specific individual on the infosphere, or 1 hour networking and gathering information. This subject is your asset. If you assess your asset via observation, you don't need to know their identity, but if you assess your asset via research or networking, you must know their identity, which requires at least two relevant pieces of information about them. Examples of relevant information could include their name, their place of origin, their current residence, the name of their parent or significant other, their employer, or their organizational affiliation. The GM determines what constitutes relevant information for this purpose, based on the asset you've selected.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Perception checks against or in relation to your asset, and a +1 circumstance bonus to attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about your asset.

You gain the benefits of the 2-action @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy] when using 1-action Get 'Em! on an asset.

You can maintain a number of assets equal to your Charisma modifier. If you Size Up other assets after that, your new asset replaces a previous one.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.XRjekIgkv8qsAxJv]{Effect: Size Up}
items.description:
频率每小时一次

你花费1分钟观察一名特定个体，花费10分钟在信息圈上研究一名特定个体，或花费1小时拓展人脉并搜集信息。此人即为你的情报对象。如果你通过观察评估情报对象，无需知道其身份；但若通过研究或人脉评估情报对象，你必须知道其身份，这至少需要两条与其相关的信息。相关信息的例子包括姓名、出生地、当前住址、父母或伴侣的姓名、雇主或所属组织。GM根据你所选的情报对象，决定什么属于适用的相关信息。

你针对情报对象或与其有关的欺骗、交涉、威吓及察觉检定获得+1环境加值，且你尝试对情报对象@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}时获得+1环境加值。

你对情报对象使用单动作的干掉他！时，获得双动作@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]的好处。

你可以维持等于自身魅力调整值数量的情报对象。此后，若你再评估其他情报对象，新对象会取代一个之前的对象。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.XRjekIgkv8qsAxJv]{效果：评估}

items.name: 计划有变！
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The target of your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy] is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You used Get 'Em! against a creature on your last turn.

When the target you directed your allies to take down falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or is destroyed, you quickly direct them at another target. You use Get 'Em! against a new target following all the normal targeting restrictions for Get 'Em! You don't count as leading by example against this new target.
items.description:
触发你的“@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]”的目标降至0生命值。

需求你上个回合对一个生物使用了“干掉他！”。

随着你指挥盟友将目标放倒至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]或摧毁，你快速将他们引导向另一个目标。你对一个新目标使用“干掉他！”，遵守“干掉他！”的所有常规限制。对新目标你不算作进行了以身作则。

items.name: 威吓射击
items.expectedDescription: You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe with your ranged weapon by firing it into the air, using ammo equal to the weapon's expend and the weapon's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take a –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.
items.description: 你尝试通过向空中开枪来对一个在你远程武器射程内的敌人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]，使用的弹药数量等于武器的耗弹量，使用武器的最大射程替代挫败士气通常的30尺范围。即便目标与你语言不通，此检定也不会受到-4环境减值。

items.name: 惊奇先攻
items.expectedDescription: You react more quickly than others can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
items.description: 你的反应比他人更迅速。你的先攻检定获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 多语言
items.expectedDescription:
You easily pick up new languages. You learn two new languages, chosen from common languages, uncommon languages, and any others you have access to. You learn an additional language if you are or become a master in Society and again if you are or become legendary.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, you learn additional languages.
items.description:
你可以轻松掌握新的语言。学习两种新语言，从常见语言、罕见语言和其它你有许可的语言中选取。若你已在社群上达到大师或之后达到大师，额外学会一种语言；已达到传奇或之后达到传奇时，再额外学会一种语言。

特殊 你可以多次选取本专长。每次都可学习额外的语言。

items.name: 名人血清
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This fizzy pink concoction is mildly intoxicating and grants a +1 item bonus to Performance checks for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.dCDZQr7EBfCALmT2]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

这种粉红色碳酸混合物略微有些令人迷醉，并在1小时内给予表演检定的+1物品加值。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.dCDZQr7EBfCALmT2]

items.name: 战术型手电筒
items.expectedDescription: A flashlight sheds bright light. A tactical flashlight emits its light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light in the next 60 feet) and is equipped with filters, which you can close to block or dim the light. Activating the filters takes an Interact action.
items.description: 手电筒发出明亮光照。战术型手电筒照亮60尺半径内的区域，并在更外60尺内提供昏暗光照；它配有滤光片，可以合上以遮挡或调暗光线。启动滤光片需要一个交互动作。

items.name: 商用型皮下注射剂
items.expectedDescription:
This tiny cylinder contains specialized nanites that either

  • Remove the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} condition
  • Decrease the value of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition by 1.
items.description:
这根细微的圆柱体容纳着特种纳米机器人。不同类型有着不同的效果。

  • 移除 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{疲乏} 状态
  • 降低其状态值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心} 状态值减少1。

items.name: 机枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These proven and reliable automatic weapons are capable of firing in short bursts or completely emptying their magazines to clear a battlefield.
items.description:
强化： 1

这些久经考验、可靠耐用的自动武器，既可以短点射，也能彻底打空弹匣，扫清战场。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 微纤护甲
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This light armor is woven from ultralight fibers that flex with a wearer's movements but turn hard as steel on impact.
items.description:
强化： 1

此轻甲以超轻纤维编织，随穿戴者的动作弯曲，但受到冲击时会硬如钢铁。

extraFields.expected:
Adjustable rings project magical holograms onto your armor, changing its appearance to match your personal style and suit any occasion. Glamer projectors come programmed with preset options, including casual, corporate, and fashion. You can customize your glamer projector using a computer, like the one in your comm unit.

Activate—Glamerize! 1 (manipulate)

Effect You instantly change the appearance of your armor to any set of normal clothes or any other type of light or heavy armor. This upgrade is capable of changing only the appearance of your armor, not yourself or the rest of your equipment. You can copy the look of any type of clothing, but you don't gain any item bonuses provided by special types of clothing, such as luxury fashion attire. Only a creature that's benefiting from truesight or a similar effect can attempt to disbelieve this illusion, opposed by your class DC.
extraFields.text:

items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This imposing pistol fires a jolt of paralyzing electricity from its barrel. Its remaining charges are visible as glowing lines of energy radiating down its body. Pulsecaster pistols are often used by bounty hunters and law enforcement who need to keep their targets alive.

强化： 1

这把威武的手枪从枪管射出一束麻痹电流。剩余充能以沿枪身延伸的发光能量线显示。赏金猎人和执法人员往往需要活捉目标，因此常用脉冲投射手枪。

items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This smoky orange liquid enhances your senses and reduces the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover by 1 against your ranged Strikes for 5 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.UB0yKVxoS0EBXyCO]

This traditional star-shaped blade design of lost Golarion is often forged from reinforced carbon steel and treated with chemicals that create an iridescent sheen. When properly balanced and honed, a shooting starknife sings as it slices through the air.

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 荒野智慧殖装
items.expectedDescription: This soft purple fungus attaches to your vocal cords and extends fine filaments into portions of your brain. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals, plants, and fungi. This communication is rudimentary and elicits basic responses, such as "hungry," "over there," or "frightened."
items.description: 这种柔软的紫色真菌会附着在你的声带上，其细细的菌丝会深入你的脑部区块。你可以向动物、植物与真菌询问问题，从它们那里得到回答，或者对它们使用交涉技能。这种沟通方式很原始，只能引导它们做出“饿了”、”在那里”与“害怕”之类的基础回答。

items.name: 拉西利特族
items.expectedDescription:
Raxilites are tiny, community-focused sapient plants with a penchant for technological innovation, especially when it comes to augmenting their bodies with useful tools.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.88ECFV3AkpR9KUfq]{Raxilite}
items.description:
拉西利特族是体型微小、重视社群的智慧植物，热衷于科技创新，尤其喜欢用实用工具强化自己的躯体。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.88ECFV3AkpR9KUfq]{拉西利特族}

items.name: LFAN
items.expectedDescription: You have a raxilite-exclusive biotech augmentation called a Lifting Floret Activation Network, or LFAN, attached to your brain stem. It consists of a cluster of artificial vines that are part mechanical and part biological. Your LFAN grants you a reach of 5 feet despite being a Tiny creature. When used together with your hands, your LFAN allows you to hold items, wield weapons, and Interact with objects as if you were a Medium creature with two hands. This augmentation doesn't count against your total implant limit.
items.description: 你的脑干连接着一件拉西利特族专属的生物工程殖装，称为抬举花簇激活网络，简称LFAN。它由一簇半机械、半生物的人造藤蔓组成。即使你是超小型生物，LFAN也能赋予你5尺触及。LFAN与你的手配合时，你可以持握物品、持用武器，并与物体交互，如同一个具有双手的中型生物。此殖装不计入你的植入物总上限。

items.name: 次世代拉西利特族
items.expectedDescription:
You come from a family that has adopted the most avant-garde tech. They were always trying out the latest augmentations, undaunted by the potential risks of using untested models. They involved you in this process from the earliest days of your life, installing a new IMAS prototype inside your body when you were a baby. Fortunately, this experiment proved successful. Your cutting-edge IMAS lets you move faster than most other raxilites.

Your Speed is 30 feet.
items.description:
你的家族接受了最前卫的科技，总是尝试最新的殖装，不惧怕未经测试型号的潜在风险。他们在你生命的最初阶段就让你参与这一过程，在你还是婴儿时，便向体内安装了一套新的IMAS原型。幸运的是，这次实验成功了。尖端IMAS使你的移动速度比大多数其他拉西利特族更快。

你的速度为30尺。

items.name: 科学家
items.expectedDescription:
You work in a lab and conduct research about a scientific topic. Perhaps you're a biotechnician, chemist, computer programmer, theoretical physicist, or accomplished researcher in some other field. Regardless of your specific training, you can employ your known science for personal gain or the betterment of galactic society.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and a Lore skill related to your field of research. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat with that Lore skill.
items.description:
你在实验室工作，研究科学课题。也许你是一个生物技术专家、化学家、计算机程序员、理论物理学家，或者在其他领域有过卓越研究成果的研究员。无论你的专业背景如何，你都能运用你所知的科学知识来获得个人利益或促进星系的社会发展。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是智力或感知，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的手艺技能和你研究领域相关的学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]（Assurance）技能专长。

items.name: 驾轻就熟
items.expectedDescription:
Even in the worst circumstances, you can perform basic tasks. Choose a skill you're trained in. You can forgo rolling a skill check for that skill to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits for that skill.
items.description:
即使在最恶劣的条件下，你也能完成基本的任务。选择一项你受训的技能，你可以放弃为该技能的技能检定掷骰，改为获得等于10+你的熟练度加值的结果（不应用任何其它加值、减值或调整值）。

特殊 你可以多次选取本专长。每次选择不同的技能获得专长效果。

extraFields.expected: trained in at least one skill

items.name: 秘术师
items.expectedDescription:
You're a conduit, channeling the fundamental forces that connect and bind everything in the cosmos. You can draw upon this supernatural wellspring to form deep spiritual bonds with your allies, empower them in combat, and restore their health should they become injured. Your powers take unique shape based on the connection you choose, granting new and more powerful spells as you explore your connection on a deeper level.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.yiqOagqH2NXjlisZ]{Mystic}

你是传导者，引导着连接并维系宇宙万物的基本力量。你可以汲取这股超自然源泉，与盟友建立深厚的灵性纽带，在战斗中强化他们，并在他们受伤时恢复其健康。你的力量因所选联结而呈现独特形态；随着你对联结的探索不断深入，你将获得新的、更强大的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.yiqOagqH2NXjlisZ]{秘术师}

items.name: 命能网络
items.expectedDescription:
Your soul supports a network of energy that connects and heals those in your bond. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to 6 + 4 Hit Points per level. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG] action that you can use to take Hit Points out of your network and into yourself or your allies as healing.

Life-and-death situations help strengthen your bonds with your allies. At the start of each turn in combat, when you regain actions, your vitality network regains 4 Hit Points; if you're master in spell DC, it regains 6 Hit Points instead; if you're legendary, it regains 8 Hit Points. When you Refocus, your vitality network regains all its Hit Points.
items.description:
你的灵魂支持着一个连结并治愈你纽带中生物的能量网络。你的命能网络具有等同于6+每等级4点生命值的最大容量。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]动作，可以用来从你的网络中提取生命值并将其转移到自己或盟友身上进行治疗。

生死攸关的情况有助于加固你与盟友的纽带。在战斗中每回合开始，当你重新获得动作时，你的命能网络会恢复4点生命值；如果你的法术DC为大师熟练度，它改为恢复6点生命值；如果你达到传奇熟练度，它会恢复8点生命值。当你再聚能时，你的命能网络会恢复全部生命值。

items.name: 联结
items.expectedDescription:
All mystics have a supernatural connection with a cosmic force that grants magical powers. The exact nature of your connection can vary widely—you might worship a god or pantheon, embody a metaphysical concept, become a conduit for nature's wrath, or something else. Even mystics who share the same connection might interpret the source of their powers differently. At 1st level, choose your connection. Your chosen connection determines the type of spells you cast and the spell tradition you choose spells from, your additional trained skill, the epiphanies you learn, and a harmony that usually grants creatures a special benefit when you heal them with your vitality network.

完美协调将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]添加到你能用协调反制的状态列表中。此外，如果你没能反制效果，但如果其反制环级低2环时你就能反制成功，则改为压制该效果，直到你的下个回合开始。效果的持续时间在被压制期间不会减少。

items.name: 初等顿悟
items.expectedDescription:
You discover the basic truth of your connection. You learn your chosen connection's initial epiphany spell. Epiphany spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to spend time with your bonded allies or otherwise ponder the nature of your connection.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.
items.description:
你发现了你联结中最基本的真理。你获得了所选联结的初始顿悟法术。顿悟法术是一种聚能法术。施放聚能法术需要消耗1点聚能点，并且你在开始时拥有一个1点聚能点的聚能池。你在每日准备时重新填满你的聚能池，你可以通过花费10分钟使用再聚能行动来恢复1点聚能点，这包括与纽带中的盟友共度时光，或思考你联结的本质。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你等级的一半，向上取整，和戏法类似。聚能法术无需法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。获取专长能够赋予你聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，不过你的聚能池不能容纳超过3点聚能点。

items.name: 秘术纽带
items.expectedDescription:
You form a bond between yourself and others, most typically your closest companions. Forming bonds is different for every mystic but always involves using a 10-minute activity related to the mystic's connection that requires you to be adjacent to the creature with whom you wish to bond. You can maintain a bond with up to 10 other willing creatures, and the bond lasts until you or the bonded creature are no longer willing to be part of the bond. You are always considered part of your own bond and don't count toward the 10-creature limit.

You always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, their Hit Point totals, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. This ability doesn't work across planes (including when in transit in the Drift), and some special magical or technological effects might interfere with your ability to detect your allies.
items.description:
你在自己和他人之间建立纽带，通常是与你最亲密的伙伴。秘术师们建立纽带的具体方式各不相同，但都需要花费一个和秘术师的联结相关的10分钟行动。你可以与至多10个其他自愿的生物建立纽带，并且纽带一直持续到你或某个被建立纽带的生物不再自愿成为纽带的一部分。你自己总是被认为是你纽带中的一部分，并且不计入10个生物的上限。

你总是知道其他联结生物的大致距离和方向，他们的生命值总数，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。这种能力在跨位面（包括漂流域中的通行）时不起作用，一些特殊的魔法或科技效果可能会干扰你侦测盟友的能力。

items.name: 秘术师施法
items.expectedDescription:
You are a spellcaster and can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a mystic, when you cast spells, you might intone a prayer or hum a song inspired by your epiphanies, you might gesture or dance in patterns that follow the flow of your connection's network, and you might accompany your spellcasting with wisps of energy flowing between you and your bonded allies.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a mystic, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast, as shown on the Mystic Spells per Day table.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Wisdom, your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks. The signature spells class feature lets you heighten certain spells freely.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of mystic spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level mystic, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level mystic, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.
items.description:
你是一名施法者，并且可以使用施法行动进行施放法术。作为一名秘术师，当你施放法术时，你可能会吟唱祷词或哼唱受顿悟启发的歌谣，你可能会用手势或舞蹈来追随你联结网络的流变，又或许会在施法时让能量丝缕在你与纽带中的盟友间流淌。

每天，你可以施放至多三个1环法术。你必须知晓法术才能施放它们，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习它们。你每天可以施放的法术数量称作你的法术位。

随着你秘术师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如秘术师每日法术表所示。

一些法术需要你尝试法术攻击来判断他们多有效，或让你的敌人掷骰对抗你的法术DC（通常是尝试豁免骰）。因为你的关键属性是感知，你的法术攻击调整和法术DC都使用你的感知调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。标志性法术职业能力可以让你自由升阶特定的法术。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整——这通常等于你拥有的秘术师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级秘术师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级秘术师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.
items.description:
秘术师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及来自你联结的额外法术和戏法。你从你联结对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术，或者从你获得许可的其他源自你魔法根源的法术中进行选择。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。当你获得新的法术环位时，你的第一个新法术总是对应环级的来自你联结的授予法术，然后你可以选择其他你获取的法术。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，可能会想替换之前学过的部分法术。每次你升级并学习新法术时，可以将一个旧法术替换为另一个同环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但你不能替换顿悟法术或联结法术。你也可以通过休整期重训替换法术。

织维巫师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及悖论赋予你的额外法术和戏法。你从你悖论对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，你可能会想要替换之前学习的一些法术。每次你获得新的等级学习新的法术时，你可以将一个旧法术置换为一个同一环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但是你不能替换悖论的授予法术。你也可以通过休整期重训来替换法术。

items.name: 群组通讯
items.expectedDescription: Creatures in your bond can communicate telepathically while within 120 feet of one another. As long as two bonded creatures are on the same plane of existence and both are alive, they remain aware of one another's present state, general direction and distance from one another, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.XSMTalRsPwQ0beIE] action.
items.description: 你纽带中的生物在彼此处于120尺内时能够通过心灵感应交流。只要两个联结生物处于同一个位面中并且都还活着，它们能够彼此知晓对方当前的状态，了解彼此的方向和距离，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.XSMTalRsPwQ0beIE]动作。

items.name: 网络法术
items.expectedDescription: You channel your spell to manifest from one of your allies instead of yourself. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with an area, range, or target, the spell manifests from one of your bonded allies instead of yourself. Use the ally's space to determine the spell's source, range, and area of effect, but line of sight and line of effect must be met from both you and your ally when the spell is cast. While this might fool someone who only sees your ally, unless you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or the spell has the subtle trait, any creature able to see both you and your ally can easily determine you're the source of the spell. If the spell has the subtle trait, you and your ally can Cast the Spell in a way that makes the ally appear to have cast it without that trait.
items.description: 你引导你的法术从你的一个盟友而不是你自己身上显现。如果你下一个动作是施放具有区域、射程或目标的法术，取代你自身，该法术从你一个纽带中的盟友处显现。使用盟友的位置来确定法术的来源，射程和效果区域，但在法术被施放时，视线和效果线必须同时从你和盟友处满足。虽然这可能会愚弄那些只看到你的盟友的人，但除非你是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]状态或该法术具有晦匿特征，否则任何能看到你和你的盟友的生物都能轻易确定你是法术的源头。如果该法术具有晦匿特征，你与盟友可通过特定施法方式使盟友看似施放了该法术且不具有晦匿特征。

items.name: 标志性法术
items.expectedDescription: You've learned to cast some of your spells more flexibly, granting you extra control over your spellcasting. For each spell rank you have access to, choose one spell of that rank to be a signature spell. You don't need to learn heightened versions of signature spells separately; instead, you can heighten these spells freely. If you've learned a signature spell at a higher level than its minimum, you can also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If you swap out a signature spell, you can choose a replacement signature spell of the same spell rank at which you learned the previous spell. You can also retrain specifically to change a signature spell to a different spell of that rank without swapping any spells; this takes as much time as retraining a spell normally does.
items.description: 你学会了更灵活地施放部分法术，赋予你对施法的额外控制力。从每个你获得的法术环级上选择一个该等级的法术作为你的标志性法术。你不需要另外学习标志性法术的升阶版本；相反，你可以自由升阶这些法术。如果你学习了一个超过原本等级的标志性法术，你可以无需学习便施展这个法术的低级版本。如果你替换了标志性法术，你可以重新选择一个相同等级法术作为新的标志性法术。你还可以通过重训在不替换法术的情况下改变标志性法术，这会花费和通常重训法术相同的时间。

items.name: 反射专家
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic Your connection blesses you with insight that helps you dodge danger. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.

Soldier You've developed a knack for dodging danger. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.

Witchwarper Your awareness of possible dangers, through incredible analysis or an understanding of the wider multiverse, increases your reflexes. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.
items.description:
秘术师 你的联结赋予你洞见，帮助你闪避危险。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

士兵 你练就了躲避危险的诀窍。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

织维巫师 你凭借惊人的分析能力，或对更广大多元宇宙的理解，察觉到潜在危险，从而增强了反应能力。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

items.name: 晕眩术
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你侵入目标的精神，利用精神冲击令目标晕眩。该冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，具有基础意志豁免。如果目标在豁免中大失败，它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+2） 该伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

items.name: 回旋弹
items.expectedDescription:
A spinning disk or smooth orb of shimmering steel leaps from one target to another. You deal 2d4 bludgeoning or slashing damage (with a basic Reflex save).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
一道由闪烁钢铁构成的旋转圆盘或光滑球体在目标之间弹射跃动。造成2d4钝击或挥砍伤害，需要进行基础反射豁免。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 命令术
items.expectedDescription:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你喊出一句难以被忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你，逃离你（如同获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态），扔下持有物，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或者站立在原地。它不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{延迟}或者使用任何反应动作，直到它服从你的命令为止。法术效果基于目标的意志豁免。

成功 目标不受影响。

升阶（5环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以海量心灵信息或神圣审判冲击一个生物的心智。这股精神猛攻造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加2d6。

items.name: 微灵盟友
items.expectedDescription:
You summon a Tiny bouncing wisp of light that easily distracts even the most determined of combatants. The wisp floats near your target. A wisp doesn't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. The wisp generates bright light in a 10-foot radius. When you Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, your wisp attempts to distract your target, which must succeed at a Will save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn. A creature who critically succeeds becomes immune to wisp ally for 1 hour.

Heightened (+1) You create one additional wisp, allowing you to choose a different target. Each wisp you create must have a different target, and all of them attempt to distract their targets at the same time when you cast or Sustain this spell.
items.description:
你召唤一只小小的活跃微灵，能够分散意志最坚定的战斗人员的注意。微灵在你目标周围悬浮游弋。微灵没有占据空间，不会提供夹击，也没有其他生物会具有的属性。微灵能在10尺半径内产生明亮光照。当你施放该法术以及每次你维持该法术时，微灵试图分散目标的注意力。该目标必须通过意志豁免，否则在你下一回合开始前将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。豁免大成功的生物将对微灵盟友临时免疫1小时。

升阶（+1）你在施法时创造出额外一只微灵，这允许你选择一个额外目标。你创造的每个微灵都必须有不同的目标，并且当你维持该法术时，它们会同时分散各自目标的注意力。

items.name: 虚假生机
items.expectedDescription:
You augment your flesh with the energies typically used to manipulate the undead. You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Vitality}
items.description:
你用通常用来操作不死生物的能量增强你的血肉。你获得10点临时生命值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{法术效果：虚假生机}

items.name: 噪鸣爆
items.expectedDescription:
A cacophonous noise blasts out, dealing 2d10 sonic damage. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.
items.description:
刺耳的噪音迸裂而出，造成2d10音波伤害。每个生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}1轮。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害，耳聋1分钟，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 1}。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 身健体康
items.expectedDescription:
You send a surge of healing energy to restore the target's body. Attempt to counteract an effect of your choice imposing one of these conditions on the target: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}. If you didn't counteract the effect, but you would have if its counteract rank were 2 lower, instead suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn. The effect's duration doesn't elapse while it's suppressed.

This spell can't counteract or suppress curses, diseases, or conditions that are part of the target's normal state.

Heightened (4th) Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} to the list of conditions.

Heightened (6th) As 4th rank, plus add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified}.

Heightened (8th) As 4th rank, plus add petrified and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.
items.description:
你送出一股治愈的能量以恢复目标的躯体。尝试反制目标上的任一个由你选择的造成下列状态的效果：@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心}。如果你未能反制该效果，但是如果其反制环阶低2的话你会成功，则改为压制该效应，直至你的下回合开始。在被压制时，该效果的持续时间不会减少。

此法术无法反制或压制诅咒、疾病或属于目标正常状态一部分的状态。

升阶（4环） 增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢}到状态列表中。

升阶（6环） 同4环阶，额外增加@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{石化}到状态列表中。

升阶（8环） 同4环阶，额外增加石化和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑}到状态列表中。

items.name: 协作本能
items.expectedDescription: Cooperation is a fundamental value on Raxil, and you were raised to always look for opportunities to work collaboratively with others. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid, and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid you.
items.description: 合作是拉西尔（Raxil）的核心价值观，而你从小便被教导，要时刻寻找与他人协力的机会。你的协助检定获得+2环境加值，盟友协助你的检定也获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 纽带增强
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A bonded ally within 20 feet is about to roll a saving throw.

You channel a surge of energy through your bond, shielding your ally's body and mind. Your ally gains a +1 status bonus to the triggering saving throw. If they roll a success on the saving throw against a vitality or void effect, they get a critical success instead.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.9Sq4P1Pxr1owEv6R]

items.expectedDescription: Your body can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1.
items.description: 在支撑到极限前，你的身体可以经受比大多数人更沉重的损伤。你的最大生命值提高等于你的等级的数值。你的恢复检定DC降低1点。

items.name: 战地医疗
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're holding or wearing a medkit.

You can patch up wounds, even in combat. Attempt a Medicine check with the same DC as for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} and restore the corresponding amount of HP; this doesn't remove the wounded condition. As with Treat Wounds, you can attempt checks against higher DCs if you have the minimum proficiency rank. The target is then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2XEYQNZTCGpdkyR6]{immune} to your Battle Medicine for 1 day. This does not make them immune to, or otherwise count as, Treat Wounds.
items.description:
需求 你正持握或穿戴医疗包。

你即使在战斗中也能包扎伤口。尝试一次医疗检定，其DC与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}相同，并恢复相应数目的生命值；这不会移除受伤状态。如同治疗伤势，只要达到最低熟练度等级要求，你就可以尝试更高DC的检定。此后，目标对你的战地医疗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2XEYQNZTCGpdkyR6]{免疫}1天。这不会使目标免疫治疗伤势，也不会以其他方式算作治疗伤势。

items.name: 战术型手电筒
items.expectedDescription: A flashlight sheds bright light. A tactical flashlight emits its light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light in the next 60 feet) and is equipped with filters, which you can close to block or dim the light. Activating the filters takes an Interact action.
items.description: 手电筒发出明亮光照。战术型手电筒照亮60尺半径内的区域，并在更外60尺内提供昏暗光照；它配有滤光片，可以合上以遮挡或调暗光线。启动滤光片需要一个交互动作。

items.name: 商用型医疗包

items.description: 这些医疗包包含了对于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]的医疗检定所必需的镇痛剂，绷带，无菌纱布以及缝合工具。医疗包是一种工具包。

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

items.expectedDescription:
