items.name: 通用聚合物
items.expectedDescription:
A universal polymer base, or UPB, is a tiny multifunction component, not much larger than a grain of rice. Used in the crafting of most common galactic goods, UPBs can be configured to act as a brace, capacitor, circuit, diode, fastener, insulator, lens, modulator, pipe, resistor, and dozens of other constituent parts. UPBs can even be spun out into fabric, broken down into component chemicals, reconstituted into new chemicals, or supplemented with base materials (such as dirt or sand) to form massive braces or walls. The right combination of hundreds or even thousands of UPBs can create everything from a comm unit to a laser weapon to powered armor. In their raw form, UPBs have a bulk of 1 per 1,000 UPBs.

UPBs are so common that they're used as currency in many major settlements and trade hubs. While credsticks are a more convenient and secure way to carry value, UPBs have the advantage of direct utility and untraceability.

Characters can use UPBs in place of credits for crafting items using maker's kits; in fact, they're necessary for the use of certain tools.
items.description:
通用聚合物，简称UPB，是一种微型多功能组件，只比米粒略大。它用于制作星系中的大多数常见商品，能配置为支架、电容器、电路、二极管、紧固件、绝缘体、透镜、调制器、管道、电阻器以及数十种其他组成零件。UPB甚至能纺成织物、分解成构成它的化学物质、重新组合成新的化学物质，或辅以泥土、沙子等基础材料，形成巨大的支架或墙壁。将数百乃至数千个UPB恰当组合，就能制造通讯单元、激光武器乃至动力甲等各种物品。原始形态的UPB每1,000个算作1负载。

UPB极其常见，因此在许多主要聚居地和贸易枢纽被当作货币使用。虽然信用棒携带财产更方便、更安全，但UPB具有实用和无法追踪的优势。

角色可以使用UPB代替信用点，以制造者工具包制作物品；事实上，使用某些工具必须消耗UPB。

items.name: 荒野智慧殖装
items.expectedDescription: This soft purple fungus attaches to your vocal cords and extends fine filaments into portions of your brain. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals, plants, and fungi. This communication is rudimentary and elicits basic responses, such as "hungry," "over there," or "frightened."
items.description: 这种柔软的紫色真菌会附着在你的声带上，其细细的菌丝会深入你的脑部区块。你可以向动物、植物与真菌询问问题，从它们那里得到回答，或者对它们使用交涉技能。这种沟通方式很原始，只能引导它们做出“饿了”、”在那里”与“害怕”之类的基础回答。

items.name: 普通容器
items.expectedDescription: Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.
items.description: 容器包含背包，公文箱，行李袋或是手提袋。一个容器最多可容纳4B物品且前2B不计入你的负载。如果你抓着容器或存放容器而非将其穿戴在个人身上，其将有L的负载而非可以忽略不计。

items.name: 露营工具包
items.expectedDescription: A camping kit contains a weatherproof tent for four Medium or two Large creatures, bedrolls, a fire igniter, 1 week of rations, and a survival knife.
items.description: 一个露营工具包包含一顶可容纳四个中型生物或两个大型生物的耐候性帐篷，铺盖卷，一个引火器，一周的口粮以及一把求生刀具。

items.name: 紧急信标
items.expectedDescription: This item requires a battery to be installed for it to operate. When activated, this small, pod-shaped device transmits its location and emits a flash of bright red light once per round, consuming 1 charge per day. Any device capable of receiving signals can pick up a signal from an emergency beacon, which can then be traced with a successful @Check[computers|dc:15] or @Check[survival|dc:15] check. An emergency beacon's transmissions have a range of 100 miles over flat terrain, 50 miles in forests or hills, and 25 miles in mountainous terrain or underwater. Alternatively, an emergency beacon can be installed in a starship's or vehicle's communications system. In this case, its range is equal to that of the communications array, and it consumes 1 charge per hour.
items.description: 此物品必须装入电池才能运作。启动后，这个豆荚形小装置会传输自身位置，并每轮闪烁一次鲜红色亮光，每天消耗1充能。任何能接收信号的设备都可以收到紧急信标的信号，然后通过成功的 @Check[computers|dc:15] 或 @Check[survival|dc:15] 检定追踪此信号。紧急信标的传输范围在平坦地形为100英里，在森林或丘陵中为50英里，在山区或水下为25英里。你也可以将紧急信标安装进星舰或载具的通信系统中。此时其范围等同于通信阵列的范围，每小时消耗1充能。

items.name: 探险者餐盒
items.expectedDescription:
This thermos has two compartments. The upper compartment contains nanomachines and filters that target common contaminants, making most food and water safe to consume and granting a +1 item bonus to saves against any poisons or diseases present in the food or water. The lower compartment converts inserted UPBs into edible nutri-paste at a rate of 2 UPBs per 1 day of nourishment.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.52tyG1y50LmTqCA9]
items.description:
这个保温壶有两个隔层。上层装有纳米机和针对常见污染物的过滤器，使大部分食物和水都能安全食用或饮用，并使对抗食物或水中任何毒素或疾病的豁免获得+1物品加值。下层会将放入的UPB转化为可食用的营养膏，每2个UPB提供1天所需的营养。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.52tyG1y50LmTqCA9]

items.name: 清洁工具包
items.expectedDescription: This kit contains all the tools and products needed to practice good grooming and hygiene. Kits designed for specific creatures include supplies (such as scale-care products for vesk or antennae grooming oil for lashuntas or shirrens) that are of less use to other creatures.
items.description: 该套工具包含全套的理容和清洁工具产品。为特定生物设计的工具包还包含对其他生物少有用到的供应品（比如为维斯克蜥人提供的鳞片护理剂或为拉申塔人和希伦虫人提供的触角保养油）。

items.name: 商用型修理工具包
items.expectedDescription: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
items.description: 修理工具包包含各种各样的允许你在旅行途中进行简单修理的精密工具和供应品。你可以用修理工具包使用手艺技能修理物品。如果你穿戴着修理工具包，你可以抽出和替换一个穿戴在身上的修理工具包，作为使用动作的一部分。

items.name: 雷弗瑞亚人
items.expectedDescription:
Ryphorians are the most widespread species of the planet Triaxus, tied to that world's eccentric orbit with a peculiar form of seasonal trimorphism that affects most of the population.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.DW80wzTy6cnkVJ0l]{Ryphorian}
items.description:
雷弗瑞亚人是崔阿克斯行星分布最广的族群。多数族人具有独特的季节性三型特征，与这颗世界的偏心轨道相联系。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.DW80wzTy6cnkVJ0l]{雷弗瑞亚人}

items.name: 缺刻耳
items.expectedDescription: Your ears are feathery and notched for finely tuned detection of sound and changes in pressure, often surprising those who thought they were hiding themselves or their machinations. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Perception checks to [[/act seek]] or for initiative rolls when opposed by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures, or to [[/act sense-motive]] to determine if a creature is verbally Lying. This benefit doesn't apply if you can't hear, or if the other creatures involved are incapable of making sound (for example, if it's affected by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{Silence} spell).
items.description: 你的耳朵呈羽毛状并带有缺口，能够敏锐察觉声音和气压变化，常让那些自以为藏好了身形或阴谋的人大吃一惊。你用于[[/act seek]]的察觉检定，对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}生物的先攻检定，以及用于[[/act sense-motive]]以判断一个生物是否正在口头说谎的察觉检定，都获得+2环境加值。如果你无法听见，或相关的其他生物无法发声，例如受到@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIdDLrbswTV3OBJy]{沉默术}法术影响，则此益处不适用。

items.name: 冬生雷弗瑞亚人
items.expectedDescription:
You have thicker skin than your summerborn cousins, topped with layers of white fur. In addition, your eyes are noticeably narrower so to avoid becoming snow-blind. Winterborn ryphorians are traditionally known to be gruff but loyal to a fault, especially when it comes to promises and oaths sworn to others. Some of these stereotypes are just that, and just as many winterborn progressives dye their fur out of artistic expression rather than to exist solely in a stodgy, stark-white state.

You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
items.description:
相比夏裔同族，你的皮肤更厚，覆有层层白色毛发。此外，你的双眼明显更狭窄，以避免雪盲。冬裔雷弗瑞亚人传统上以粗犷却忠诚得近乎过头著称，尤其重视向他人许下的承诺和誓言。其中有些刻板印象仅仅是刻板印象，也有同样多的进步派冬裔会为艺术表达而给毛发染色，不愿始终保持一本正经的纯白模样。

你获得等于自身等级一半的寒冷抗力，最低为1。你将环境寒冷效果的严重程度视为降低一级，例如酷寒变为极寒，极寒变为严寒，依此类推。

items.name: 太空旅者
items.expectedDescription:
Some people might say you've been out in the Drift too long, but the truth is, you don't feel at home away from your post on a starship deck. You might crew a long-haul freighter, military gunship, or tourist shuttle. Truth is, you'd probably sign up for any job that took you off-world.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Piloting skill and the Drift Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.K2R1xGTgBnSCDMUl]{Express Driver} skill feat.
items.description:
有些人可能会说你在漂流域中度过的时间太长了，但事实上，你早已无法适应远离星舰甲板的生活。无论是长途货运飞船、军用炮艇，还是观光穿梭机——只要能让你离开行星，你大概会毫不犹豫地签下任何工作合约。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是敏捷或体质，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的驾驶技能和漂流域学识（Drift Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.K2R1xGTgBnSCDMUl]（Express Driver）技能专长。

items.name: 特快司机
items.expectedDescription: You know how to get there fast. When calculating your travel Speed for the day while piloting a vehicle, you can attempt a Piloting check to increase your vehicle's travel Speed for long-term overland or aerial travel. The DC is determined by the GM but is typically based on the vehicle's piloting DC or a difficulty based on the environment, whichever is harder. On a success, double your vehicle's travel Speed for the day. This has no effect on your vehicle's movement in encounters or on starships traveling through the Drift.
items.description: 你懂得如何迅速抵达目的地。驾驶载具并计算当天的旅行速度时，你可以尝试驾驶检定，提高载具在长期陆路或空中旅行时的旅行速度。DC由GM决定，通常采用载具驾驶DC或基于环境的难度，取较高者。成功时，载具当天的旅行速度翻倍。这不影响载具在遭遇中的移动，也不影响通过漂流域航行的星舰。

items.name: 特工
items.expectedDescription:
You're a focused, quick-witted professional who thrives in high-stakes combat. Your deadly aim and tactical training give you an edge over the competition—for you, even the most powerful enemy is just another mark to take out. You have impressive prowess in your chosen field of specialization.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.e3x0k83hYe1awVvT]{Operative}
items.description:
你是专注而机敏的专业人士，在生死攸关的战斗中如鱼得水。致命的枪法与战术训练使你在较量中占尽上风——对你而言，即使最强大的敌人也只是另一个需要解决的目标。你在自己选择的专精领域中拥有非凡的造诣。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.kzxu2dI7tFxv6Ix6.JournalEntryPage.e3x0k83hYe1awVvT]{特工}

items.name: 神射手
items.expectedDescription: You can spot a target's weak points, letting you deal additional precision damage with most types of ranged weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] action.
items.description: 你能看穿目标的弱点，令你可以用大多数类型的远程武器造成额外精准伤害。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]动作。

items.name: 特工专精
items.expectedDescription:
As an operative, you have a particular set of skills based on your tactical style. These different specializations help define your character and the approach you take to most situations. Choose an operative's specialization. This specialization grants you training in one skill, a skill feat for that skill, and an exploit. At 9th level, you gain the enhanced exploit granted by your specialization. The specializations presented in this book are as follows.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.1bgDbGzALewzo7cy]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.u4hB3FGFJwGtjrZB]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.HSKJ1VkPdlMkcqzc]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.OCWsQQ95P7ecp7Rn]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.EpxKCi6G0KnWQhHP]
items.description:
作为特工，你拥有一套基于你战术风格的独特技能组。这些不同的专精有助于明确你的角色和你在大多数情况下采取的行动方式。选择一项特工专精，专精会提供一项技能上的受训，一个对应的技能专长及一项秘技。9级时，你获得专精提供的进阶秘技。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.1bgDbGzALewzo7cy]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.u4hB3FGFJwGtjrZB]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.HSKJ1VkPdlMkcqzc]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.OCWsQQ95P7ecp7Rn]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.EpxKCi6G0KnWQhHP]

items.name: 瞄准
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait.

You take careful aim at a single creature that you're aware of, designating it as your mark until your next turn. Your ranged Strikes against your mark using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 1. These benefits only apply if your mark is within your weapon's first range increment. You can only have one mark at a time.

As your operative level increases, so does your ability to Aim. Increase the number of dice for the precision damage by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels. At 11th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 2 rather than 1. At 17th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 4 rather than 2.
items.description:
需求 你持用一把不带有区域特征的远程武器。

你仔细瞄准一个你能感知到的生物，直到你的下一回合前将其指定为你的标靶。你使用需求的远程武器对标靶生物进行的远程打击会造成额外1d4精准伤害，并将你标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低1。这些增益只会在标靶处于你武器的第一射程增量内时有效。你同一时间只能有一个标靶。

随着你的特工等级提升，你的瞄准技巧也得到改进。在5、11、17级时，精准伤害的伤害骰增加一个。11级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低2而非1。17级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低4而非2。

items.name: 游击兵
items.expectedDescription:
You specialize in close-quarters missions that require you to operate in crowded or tight spaces, such as inside buildings or vehicles, down narrow alleys, or in busy downtown streets. Whether you're a mugger, bodyguard, assassin, or urban mercenary, you favor pistols and can use them efficiently in tight spaces. You're trained in Acrobatics. You gain a skill feat for Acrobatics.

Exploit: You're trained to fight in close combat using pistols. Your ranged Strikes with one-handed ranged weapons don't trigger reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

Enhanced Exploit: Your point-blank shots are particularly deadly. When you make a successful Strike against an adjacent enemy with a one-handed ranged weapon, you calculate the damage as if the lowest-rolled weapon damage die for the attack had the maximum result instead. At 17th level, the two lowest-rolled damage dice increase to the maximum result.
items.description:
你专精于在拥挤和狭窄的空间中执行近距离任务，如建筑物内部、载具内、狭窄的小巷和繁忙的商业街。无论你是抢劫犯、保镖、刺客还是城市雇佣兵，你偏爱手枪，并能在狭小空间内高效地使用它们。你在特技上受训，并获得一个特技技能专长。

秘技：你受到训练，在近距离冲突中使用手枪战斗。你使用单手远程武器的远程攻击不会触发因远程攻击而触发的反应。

进阶秘技：你的近距离射击格外致命。当你用单手远程武器对相邻敌人进行一次成功的打击时，你将掷出的最低的武器伤害骰视为最大值。在17级时，你将掷出的最低的两个伤害骰变为最大值。

items.name: 四平八稳
items.expectedDescription: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.
items.description: 即使在恶劣的条件下，你也能轻易保持平衡。每当你检定成功地使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{保持平衡}动作时，改为大成功。你在狭窄平面和不稳地面尝试保持平衡时不会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

items.name: 专心致志
items.expectedDescription: You're highly focused on your target and able to discern their moves. When you roll a success on a Reflex or Will save against your mark, you get a critical success instead.
items.description: 你的高度专注于目标，可以识别他们的行动。当你在对抗你标靶的反射豁免或意志豁免中成功时，将结果改为大成功。

items.name: 专精技能组
items.expectedDescription: At 3rd level, 7th level, and 15th level, you gain a skill feat. This feat must be for the trained skill from your operative's specialization.
items.description: 3级，7级，15级时，你获得一个技能专长。该专长必须是来自你的特工专精所提供的受训技能。

items.name: 碳素皮肤
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This form-fitting suit of carbon fiber encases the body. Most are usually dull-gray, functional garments, while pricier, bespoke suits dazzle like diamonds.
items.description:
强化： 1

这件贴身的碳纤维服将身体包裹起来。多数是暗灰色的实用服装，而更昂贵的定制服装则像钻石般耀眼。

items.name: 战术型渗透者工具包
items.expectedDescription: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill. A tactical infiltrator's toolkit adds a +1 item bonus to checks to Pick Locks or Disable Devices.
items.description: 你需要渗透者工具包来 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{开锁} 或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{解除装置} （某些类型），使用贼活技能。战术型渗透者工具包为开锁或解除装置检定提供+1物品加值。

items.name: 渗透者血清
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This oily serum grants a +1 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.zXZoUqxzXFisGqmw]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 共感联结
items.expectedDescription: Dragonkin have the ability to form permanent bonds with a chosen partner. Some ryphorians, through countless years of close proximity to the draconic inhabitants of Triaxus, have learned to emulate this ability to a limited degree. You can form a temporary bond with one willing sapient creature as a 10-minute activity that can only be attempted if you and your partner share a deep bond. Once formed, this bond lasts for 1 day. When you're within 30 feet of this bonded creature, you both gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.
items.description: 龙人能够与选定的伙伴建立永久纽带。经过无数年与崔阿克斯的龙类居民密切相处，一些雷弗瑞亚人学会了有限地模仿这种能力。你可以用一个10分钟的活动，与一个自愿的智慧生物建立临时纽带，但只有在你和伙伴已经有深厚联系时才能尝试。纽带一旦形成，便持续1天。你与此生物相距30尺以内时，双方的意志豁免都获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 弱化射击
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You target a creature's limbs or load-bearing appendages to weaken them. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the creature becomes your choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical hit).
items.description:
需求你持用一把枪械

你瞄准生物的四肢或其他附肢以削弱它们。你瞄准，然后对你的标靶进行一次远程打击。如果攻击命中，生物变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，由你选择，直到你下回合结束（重击时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭2}）。

items.name: 抢人头
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An ally ends their turn after hitting a creature two or more times or critically hitting a creature.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire a quick shot at a foe your ally is focusing their attacks on. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] at the creature your triggering ally hit and then make a ranged Strike against that creature.
items.description:
触发一个盟友在命中一个生物两次及以上或重击一个生物后结束他们的回合。

需求你持用一把枪械。

你向一个盟友正在全力攻击的生物打出一发快枪。你@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]你的触发盟友命中的生物，然后对该生物进行一次远程打击。

items.name: 审时度势（强韧）
items.expectedDescription: Your avoidance or observation is beyond the ken of most in your profession. Choose Fortitude saves, Reflex saves, Will saves, or Perception. You become an expert in your choice. At 17th level, you become a master in your choice.
items.description: 你躲避危险的能力和观察力让大多数同僚相形见绌。选择强韧豁免、反射豁免、意志豁免或察觉。你在所选能力上的熟练度变为专家。达到17级时，所选能力的熟练度变为大师。

items.name: 飞扑卧倒
items.expectedDescription: When threatened, you can quickly take a dive and find somewhere to hunker down. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}, which allows you to hunker down and gain greater cover against ranged attacks.
items.description: 当受到威胁时，你可以迅速飞扑，找到可以伏身的地方。你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{跳跃}，着陆时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，随后立即@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{寻找掩蔽}，从而压低身形，获得对远程攻击的高等掩蔽。

items.name: 地形潜伏（灌木丛）
items.expectedDescription:
Select one type of difficult terrain from the following list: rubble, snow, or underbrush. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by all non-allies in that type of terrain, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} without attempting a Stealth check as long as you move no more than 5 feet and do not pass within 10 feet of an enemy during your movement.

During exploration, this also allows you to automatically approach within 15 feet of other creatures while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{Avoiding their Notice}, as long as they aren't actively @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} or on guard.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different type of terrain.
items.description:
从下列困难地形中选择一项：石堆、雪地、灌木丛。当你在该地形中对所有非盟友处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪}状态时，只要移动距离不超过5尺，也未在移动过程中进入敌人10尺范围内，你无需尝试隐秘检定就可以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{潜行}。

在探索期采取@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.IE2nThCmoyhQA0Jn]{避免被察觉}行动期间，本专长还令你能够自动接近其他生物15尺内，前提是他们未在主动@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜索}或保持警戒。

特殊 你可以多次选取本专长。每次选择不同类型的地形。

items.name: 商用型爆燃手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 1d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:5]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击击退5尺

这类手雷点燃化学物质，引发炽热的爆炸，造成1d8点火焰伤害，并进行 @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] 豁免（@Template[burst|distance:5]）。如果你可以使用手雷的重击专精效果，对抗燃烧手雷的豁免检定大失败的生物会被推离手雷。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
items.description:
强化： 0

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

items.name: 音爆手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

A boom pistol resembles a megaphone with a trigger, emitting sudden bursts of sound capable of shattering bulletproof glass or rupturing organs.
items.description:
强化： 1

轰鸣手枪形似带扳机的扩音器，能发出突如其来的强烈声响，足以震碎防弹玻璃或震破内脏。

items.name: 轻灵兽
items.expectedDescription: Skittermanders are energetic, six-armed humanoids with brightly colored fur. Skittermanders accomplish tasks with chaotic enthusiasm and typically enjoy teamwork, defying even their would-be conquerors through collaboration.
items.description: 轻灵兽是精力充沛的六臂类人生物，覆有鲜艳的毛发。轻灵兽以混乱的热情完成任务，通常喜欢团队合作，甚至会通过协作来抗衡试图征服它们的人。

items.name: 六臂
items.expectedDescription: You have six arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to six hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action, which is a single action. You can wield items only with your active hands.
items.description: 你有六条手臂，这使得你可以持握和持用多达六只占用手的武器和装备。任何时候，一双手被指定为你的启动手。你可以通过换手动作切换为另一双启动手，这是一个单动作。你只能使用启动手执行动作。有关扮演超过两只手的角色的更多信息，请参考第254页。

items.name: 轻灵社群抚养
items.expectedDescription: You've spent your life as part of a tight-knit community, where teamwork makes the dream work and crowds are giant group hugs waiting to happen. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid an ally at skill checks that don't have the attack trait.
items.description: 你一生中大部分时间都在一个紧密团结的社区中度过，通过协作实现梦想，邻里亲密无间。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]技能专长。此外，你在协助一名盟友进行非攻击特征的技能检定时获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 集体印象
items.expectedDescription: When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, you can compare your Diplomacy check result to the Will DCs of up to 10 targets you conversed with, with no penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 if you're an expert, 50 if you're a master, and 100 if you're legendary.
items.description: 在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}时，你可以将交涉检定结果与跟你交流的至多10个目标的意志DC相比较，且无需承受减值。若你在交涉技能上的熟练度达到专家，目标数量提高到20个；若达到大师，提高到50个；若达到传奇，提高到100个。

items.name: 诈骗者
items.expectedDescription:
You're a con artist and trickster who swindles unsuspecting dupes and blackmails rubes, but it's nothing personal—you're just in it for the credits. You might run an operation on the side, or you might spend your career moving from settlement to settlement until you get caught in the act.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill and a Lore skill related to a profession or subject you fake expertise in. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat.
items.description:
你是个诈骗高手，专门坑骗毫无戒心的冤大头，甚至敲诈那些容易上当的人——但这并非针对个人，你只是为了钱。你可能一边经营着自己的骗局，也可能四处流窜作案，直到被抓个正着。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是智力或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的欺骗技能和与你伪装专业知识相关的学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]（Charming Liar）技能专长。

items.name: 蛊惑人心
items.expectedDescription: Your charm allows you to win over those you lie to. When you get a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step, as though you'd succeeded at using Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}. This works only once per conversation, and if you critically succeed against multiple targets using the same result, you choose one creature's attitude to improve. You must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate your status, or ingratiate yourself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.
items.description: 凭借魅力，你能够将欺骗对象笼络为你的支持者。当你用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{说谎}动作取得大成功时，目标对你的态度改善一级，如同你用交涉技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}成功。每次交流，这个效果只会生效一次，如果你用相同结果对多个目标取得大成功，则选择一个生物的态度得到改善。你的谎言必须要透露看似重要的信息、鼓吹自己的地位、或巴结奉承对方，无关紧要的谎言无法起到作用。

items.name: 使节
items.expectedDescription: You're a master influencer. You make your way in the universe with a charming smile, quick wit, and keen sense of self-preservation. You're a leader who motivates your teammates, pushes them past their limits, and helps them through tough spots. You excel at getting others to do what you want, but you're always ready to face trouble head-on when things take a turn for the worse. You might be a con artist, diplomat, performer, or military officer—or you might take on whatever role the situation demands.
items.description: 你是影响他人的大师。你凭借迷人的微笑、敏捷的才思和敏锐的自保意识闯荡宇宙。你是激励队友、推动他们突破极限并助其渡过难关的领袖。你擅长让他人依照你的意愿行事，但在局势恶化时，也总准备好直面麻烦。你可能是骗子、外交官、表演者或军官，也可能根据局势的需要扮演任何角色。

items.name: 使节指令
items.expectedDescription:
Envoys encourage their allies with directives. A directive is an order that benefits allies who follow it. Envoy directives include a way for the envoy to lead by example by spending more actions for increased effects. Directives have the auditory or visual trait depending on how you inspire your allies.

You begin with one envoy directive. You can learn more directives through the envoy class, envoy class feats, and your leadership style. You can issue one directive a round. Unless otherwise stated, an envoy's directive and the benefits it grants last until the beginning of your next turn.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy] envoy directive.
items.description:
使节通过指令来鼓励盟友。指令是对遵守指令的盟友有利的命令。使节指令包括让使节以身作则的方式，花费更多动作来获得更多效果。指令具有听觉或视觉特征，取决于你激励盟友的方式。

你初始有一个使节指令。你可以通过使节职业，使节职业专长，和你的领导风格学到更多指令。你每轮可以下达一个指令。除非另有说明，使节的指令及其赋予的增益会持续到你的下回合开始。

你获得“@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]”使节指令。

items.name: 领导风格
items.expectedDescription:
Whether it comes naturally, or you trained for it, you've developed a personal style of leading others. At 1st level, select a leadership style. You become trained in the indicated leadership skill, you gain the indicated leadership perk, and know the associated leadership directive.

items.name: 干掉他！
items.expectedDescription:
You single out an enemy for you and your allies to focus your attacks on. Select an enemy within 60 feet that you can see. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attacks against that target until the beginning of your next turn.

Lead by Example If you used two actions, Strike the target. You gain a status bonus to the damage roll equal to your Charisma modifier. Regardless of whether the Strike hits, you and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to damage on subsequent Strikes made against the enemy until the start of your next turn. Increase the damage by 1 at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.ey2zSEnprAGgvrij]
items.description:
你选定一名敌人，让自己和盟友集中攻击它。选择60尺内你能看见的一个敌人。你和盟友对该目标的攻击获得+1状态加值，直到你的下个回合开始。

以身作则 若你使用了两个动作，打击该目标。你在伤害掷骰中获得等同于自身魅力调整值的状态加值。无论该次打击是否命中，你和盟友随后对该敌人进行打击时，伤害均获得+1状态加值，直到你的下个回合开始。此伤害在以下每个等级增加1：5、10、15与20级。

Leadership Skill Stealth

Leadership Perk You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance (Stealth)} as a bonus feat.

items.expectedDescription:
With perfect timing, you call on hidden allies to take down an unsuspecting target. Designate an enemy creature within 60 feet and an ally within 60 feet. If the ally is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9evPzg9E6muFcoSk]{Unnoticed} to the target at the start of their turn, they treat the target as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of their turn instead of when they become visible to the target.

items.description:
恰到好处的时机，你呼唤藏匿的盟友击倒毫无防备的目标。指定一个60尺内的敌方生物和一名60尺内的盟友。如果该盟友在其回合开始时对目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9evPzg9E6muFcoSk]状态，则他将该目标视作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]，直到其回合结束，而非仅直到其对目标变为可见前。

items.name: 保底（隐秘）
items.expectedDescription:
Even in the worst circumstances, you can perform basic tasks. Choose a skill you're trained in. You can forgo rolling a skill check for that skill to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits for that skill.
items.description:
即使在最恶劣的条件下，你也能完成基本的任务。选择一项你受训的技能，你可以放弃为该技能的技能检定掷骰，改为获得等于10+你的熟练度加值的结果（不应用任何其它加值、减值或调整值）。

特殊 你可以多次选取本专长。每次选择不同的技能获得专长效果。

items.name: 超速
items.expectedDescription: You're full of energy, and you often bound into action faster than your friends can keep up. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

以身作则如果你使用两个动作，你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]。且60尺内任意盟友可以用一个反应动作寻找掩蔽。
